P2R0G19B_K31_FUTURE_Z22_TRANSIENT.result: The source is transiently available, but useful independent value is unproved. It must cover all later effects, fit the cost allowance, and improve error by at least 2.86e-10.

P2R0G19B_LITERAL_D11_Q211_ACQUISITION_GA.title: The current CP4 state misses new off-diagonal q211 terms
P2R0G19B_LITERAL_D11_Q211_ACQUISITION_GA.summary: Test whether the existing D11 representation can acquire off-diagonal q211 contributions created by a reset.
P2R0G19B_LITERAL_D11_Q211_ACQUISITION_GA.result: It cannot in general: it transports inherited rank-one factors and adds diagonal terms only, while its other summaries are unchanged on a distinguishing example. This closes the current interface, not all possible representations.

P2R0G19B_Q22_Q211_SEWING_THEOREM.title: Combining Q22 diagonals and q211 off-diagonals
P2R0G19B_Q22_Q211_SEWING_THEOREM.summary: Assemble collision-normalized Q22 and q211 terms into symmetric slices and derive their common-factor and quotient ranks.
P2R0G19B_Q22_Q211_SEWING_THEOREM.result: The coefficient-space identity and rank statements were proved. They do not show that a rank-one representation actually occurs along the deployed estimator’s trajectory.

P2R0G19B_H211_GATE_SCALARIZATION_NOGO.title: One scalar cannot represent a generic biased H211 reset
P2R0G19B_H211_GATE_SCALARIZATION_NOGO.summary: Test whether the reset’s several Hermite contributions can be compressed into a single scalar direction.
P2R0G19B_H211_GATE_SCALARIZATION_NOGO.result: A generic biased reset has an unavoidable second independent direction. A rank-one premise therefore fails except under special parity or shared-leg structure.

P2R0G19B_NCQC_JOINT_FIBER_REFIT.title: Choosing the joint covariance and third-order state across depth
P2R0G19B_NCQC_JOINT_FIBER_REFIT.summary: Find a deployable rule for selecting and updating the signed state orientation that covariance alone leaves undetermined.
P2R0G19B_NCQC_JOINT_FIBER_REFIT.result: Unresolved. The method needs an explicit initialization and update with conditioning across networks, or a demonstration that an unstable hidden direction prevents it.

P2R0G19B_AD2_FIDELITY_GATE.title: How accurate must the variance correction be?
P2R0G19B_AD2_FIDELITY_GATE.summary: Bound the combined error from the variance provider and associated higher-order terms before claiming a final raw-error target.
P2R0G19B_AD2_FIDELITY_GATE.result: Even with exact later channels, retaining less than 0.95696 of the relevant coefficient loses the target. Additional source and higher-order errors tighten the requirement; the full bound remains unproved.

P2R0G19B_AK_SHARED_REVERSE_FULL_SEAM.title: A shared reverse pass must carry all required moment terms
P2R0G19B_AK_SHARED_REVERSE_FULL_SEAM.summary: Account for K4, K31, both K22 pieces, q211, and persistent third-order effects at the same layer boundary.
P2R0G19B_AK_SHARED_REVERSE_FULL_SEAM.result: A K31-only reverse row is incomplete. A literal shared-buffer and operation identity is still needed; otherwise the omitted work requires another charged reverse pass.

P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_TWO_RAY_SOURCE.title: Why one global pairing scalar cannot repair a local two-ray change
P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_TWO_RAY_SOURCE.summary: Represent a local rank-two K22 change using the current CP4 factors plus the estimator’s single dense pairing direction.
P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_TWO_RAY_SOURCE.result: The scalar also changes unrelated entries, so the representation fails in this form. It would require exact proportionality to the existing pairing plane or a separate localized K22 compensator.

P2R0G19B_Q211_NATIVE_P_RANK_COST.title: The rank limit for reducing an already stored product matrix
P2R0G19B_Q211_NATIVE_P_RANK_COST.summary: Price a dense reduction when its product matrix P is already available, and compare full, diagonal, and factored target support.
P2R0G19B_Q211_NATIVE_P_RANK_COST.result: One spare compute equivalent covers dense support only through rank five. Whether the complete target support stays within the relevant ceiling after collisions and other corrections remains unresolved.

P2R0G19B_NCQC_H4_SOURCE_FUSION.title: Acquiring the leading square of the fourth-order source
P2R0G19B_NCQC_H4_SOURCE_FUSION.summary: Determine how to construct the H4-square Gram contribution needed by the suffix calculation, rather than counting only its later transport.
P2R0G19B_NCQC_H4_SOURCE_FUSION.result: The existing operation budget omits generic pairwise source construction. An explicit resident or fused source is still needed; otherwise those additional operations must be charged.

P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_SIX_RAY_PERSISTENT.title: A six-ray CP representation that survives repeated dense resets
P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_SIX_RAY_PERSISTENT.summary: Use six-ray polarization to carry the exact source without introducing K22 or K31 compensating terms.
P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_SIX_RAY_PERSISTENT.result: The representation has the required algebraic form, but usable deployment remains open. All retained source amplitudes must be acquired and their grouped transport proved across the active injection sites.

P2R0G19B_AQ_Q211_MULTIRESIDUAL_L4_BOUND.title: Bounding q211 error from several residual sources
P2R0G19B_AQ_Q211_MULTIRESIDUAL_L4_BOUND.summary: Separate the quadratic projection, the AQ state beyond that projection, and the true-minus-AQ residual; bound their mixed contributions in directional L4 norms.
P2R0G19B_AQ_Q211_MULTIRESIDUAL_L4_BOUND.result: A sharp deterministic bound was proved, including the mixed residual terms. The directional true-minus-approximation radii needed to evaluate it are not available in the stored state.

P2R0G19B_AQ_AFFINE_H4_BAND_QUERY_RANK.title: A cheap H4 contraction requires a low-rank output query
P2R0G19B_AQ_AFFINE_H4_BAND_QUERY_RANK.summary: Exploit factorized output weights to contract the affine H4 band with a few elementwise-power matrix-vector products.
P2R0G19B_AQ_AFFINE_H4_BAND_QUERY_RANK.result: The formula is cheap for a few factors, but generic pair support expands to full width. A rank bound within the D10 allowance, while preserving independent target value, remains to be proved.

P2R0G19B_R55_FIRST_ORDER_HOOK_THRESHOLD.title: A rank-55 first-order state cannot match the required information
P2R0G19B_R55_FIRST_ORDER_HOOK_THRESHOLD.summary: After matching the affine K21 terms, test whether a rank-55 affine or first-order correction can retain the remaining covariance directions.
P2R0G19B_R55_FIRST_ORDER_HOOK_THRESHOLD.result: A dimensional theorem leaves at least 102,831 covariance modes invisible to every first-order kernel. This excludes the proposed affine and near-affine rank-55 forms; any finite-cut escape must begin at cubic order.

P2R0G19B_AQ_GAUSSIAN_BASE_CUMULANT_BRANC.title: Finite response corrections around the Gaussian covariance state
P2R0G19B_AQ_GAUSSIAN_BASE_CUMULANT_BRANC.summary: Keep the existing Gaussian covariance plane and use the affine-quadratic state only for finite local response corrections.
P2R0G19B_AQ_GAUSSIAN_BASE_CUMULANT_BRANC.result: This avoids a new Gram read but cannot claim the full covariance and K21 information of the richer law. Exact finite formulas, nonduplicate terms, final-output effects, and a sufficiently small remainder remain unresolved.

P2R0G19B_AQ_FROZEN_GREST_BELLMAN_GATE.title: Bounding the error from retaining the old covariance frame
P2R0G19B_AQ_FROZEN_GREST_BELLMAN_GATE.summary: Treat the current D10 frame as a control variate and track the final effect of its mismatch and new non-Gaussian contributions.
P2R0G19B_AQ_FROZEN_GREST_BELLMAN_GATE.result: The cheaper subtotal does not eliminate accumulated error or signed cross terms. A full output-error bound within the remaining oracle-improvement allowance is still needed.

P2R0G19B_Q211_AABC_RESET_CLOSURE.title: A repeated-factor fourth-order class fails under generic resets
P2R0G19B_Q211_AABC_RESET_CLOSURE.summary: Test whether the AABC tensor class remains closed when a correlated reset changes one of its repeated factors.
P2R0G19B_Q211_AABC_RESET_CLOSURE.result: The transformed expression lacks the term required to stay in that class. It is not a universal persistent carrier; restricted resets, immediate consumption, or a bounded output defect would need separate justification.

P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_FINAL_SECTION.title: Rank 55 cannot generically preserve the full future pair state
P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_FINAL_SECTION.summary: Check whether a rank-55 interface can match all pair directions that later ReLU operations can detect.
P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_FINAL_SECTION.result: The generic interface is short by at least 465,357 dimensions. The impossibility result applies to complete future equivalence; a smaller bound would require proof that the deployed state has a genuinely smaller pair tangent.

P2R0G19B_AQ_PRICE_SOURCE_INFORMATION.title: Known covariance information still needs an explicit trace readout
P2R0G19B_AQ_PRICE_SOURCE_INFORMATION.summary: Separate whether the Price correction contains new information from whether the existing implementation can compute its required trace.
P2R0G19B_AQ_PRICE_SOURCE_INFORMATION.result: Covariance and marginals already determine the source, so it adds no information. However, the current CP4 and Q24 summaries do not expose the strict trace readout. Cost and output value remain separate questions.

P2R0G19B_R63_GENERIC_ACQUISITION_COST_NO.title: Generic acquisition of a rank-63 state exceeds the compute allowance
P2R0G19B_R63_GENERIC_ACQUISITION_COST_NO.summary: Price carrying the rank-63 factors from earlier layers or reconstructing them by a reverse computation at the late-layer boundary.
P2R0G19B_R63_GENERIC_ACQUISITION_COST_NO.result: The two generic options cost about 18.27 and 10 compute equivalents, while less than one remains. No factor bank is already stored. A specific resident view or low-rank fixed-suffix action would be a different construction.

P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_RELU_SURFACE_RANK_NOGO.title: Generic ReLU boundary corrections require full-width surface rank
P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_RELU_SURFACE_RANK_NOGO.summary: Test whether low matrix rank also makes the functional Hessian contributions on ReLU boundaries low rank.
P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_RELU_SURFACE_RANK_NOGO.result: Distinct affine ReLU boundaries are generically independent, giving one surface direction per unit even with a rank-one terminal matrix. Special identical surfaces, invariant blocks, or exact streamed contractions remain exceptions.

P2R0G19B_R63_JOINT_STRONG_SEAM_GATE.title: Can a jointly fitted rank-63 state satisfy the full interface?
P2R0G19B_R63_JOINT_STRONG_SEAM_GATE.summary: Allow both first- and second-order coordinates to move, and count whether rank 63 can match K21 and an independent complete pair interface.
P2R0G19B_R63_JOINT_STRONG_SEAM_GATE.result: Joint rank 63 is the first counted case with a positive margin, 29,791 dimensions. Dimension counting is not enough: full Jacobian rank, usable conditioning, and no double counting of existing pair state remain unproved.

P2R0G19B_R62_CUBIC_NORMAL_MAP.title: The cubic correction to the rank-62 normal map
P2R0G19B_R62_CUBIC_NORMAL_MAP.summary: Eliminate gauge and regular directions to derive the first nontrivial cubic contribution to the reduced rank-62 map.
P2R0G19B_R62_CUBIC_NORMAL_MAP.result: The exact expansion t S1 + t³ S3 + O(t⁵) and an equivalent adjoint formula were established. Full rank, numerical conditioning, and existence of an admissible state still need separate proofs.

P2R0G19B_R62_WEAK_FIBER_H3_NOGO.title: Matching 561 covariance modes does not control third-order error
P2R0G19B_R62_WEAK_FIBER_H3_NOGO.summary: Compare the rank-62 interface’s 561 residual covariance modes with the full space of strict symmetric third-order sources.
P2R0G19B_R62_WEAK_FIBER_H3_NOGO.result: At least 177,944,931 generic third-order directions remain outside the interface’s image. The small covariance-mode count therefore cannot be used as evidence that third-order information is retained.

P2R0G19B_PRICE_FORWARD_PAIR_PLANES.title: Forward formulas for trace-induced moment planes
P2R0G19B_PRICE_FORWARD_PAIR_PLANES.summary: Express K4, K31, and K22 for a symmetrized product of two matrices using their entries and diagonals.
P2R0G19B_PRICE_FORWARD_PAIR_PLANES.result: The formulas require O(n²) work. Repeated source injections generally add distinct transported pair factors, so the identity does not establish bounded state size across depth or ownership of strict q211 terms.

P2R0G19B_AFFINE_Q211_PHYSICAL_ENDPOINT_R.title: The physical q211 output weights may require many factors
P2R0G19B_AFFINE_Q211_PHYSICAL_ENDPOINT_R.summary: Check the rank of the actual variance-output weights before pricing their contraction as one matrix sandwich per layer.
P2R0G19B_AFFINE_Q211_PHYSICAL_ENDPOINT_R.result: Generic output and pair kernels have high rank, so that simple cost count is insufficient. A low-rank physical approximation needs a certified remaining action error and held-out correlation.

P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_CURRENT_TAPE_REVERSE_N.title: The current forward computation cannot supply a free reverse pass
P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_CURRENT_TAPE_REVERSE_N.summary: Audit whether the D10/Q24 calculation retains the future sensitivities and Price factors needed for reverse correction.
P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_CURRENT_TAPE_REVERSE_N.result: It folds its powers directly into forward moment planes and stores neither bank. Reusing subexpressions in a new reverse pass can save work, but the pass and its clipping, scaling, and repair derivatives must still be charged.

P2R0G19B_AQ_POLYNOMIAL_ONE_GRAM_IDENTITY.title: One polynomial Gram product also encodes symmetric K31
P2R0G19B_AQ_POLYNOMIAL_ONE_GRAM_IDENTITY.summary: Mix first- and third-degree polynomial features before forming a single Gram matrix.
P2R0G19B_AQ_POLYNOMIAL_ONE_GRAM_IDENTITY.result: Its derivative at zero mixing equals (K31 + K31ᵀ)/6, providing an exact algebraic identity without a second product. Valid distribution semantics, positive-semidefinite scaling, reset closure, and prediction value remain separate.

P2R0G19B_AQ_FREE_PAIR_ZERO_BIAS_VALUE_NO.title: The free fourth-order pair term vanishes at zero bias
P2R0G19B_AQ_FREE_PAIR_ZERO_BIAS_VALUE_NO.summary: Evaluate whether the free fourth-order pair sector can explain the measured broad covariance correction in a zero-bias ReLU layer.
P2R0G19B_AQ_FREE_PAIR_ZERO_BIAS_VALUE_NO.result: Its pair action is exactly zero except for a rank-one marginal-mean counterterm. It cannot supply the broad additive mechanism in that setting; bias and other residual sources were not ruled out.

P2R0G19B_Q211_DIRECT_GENERIC_RANK1024_NO.title: Generic direct q211 computation needs 1,024 queries
P2R0G19B_Q211_DIRECT_GENERIC_RANK1024_NO.summary: Count the independent direct-surface queries required when the q211 residual has generic independent slices.
P2R0G19B_Q211_DIRECT_GENERIC_RANK1024_NO.result: The count is the full width, 1,024, far above the single-digit native allowance and roughly hundred-query replacement ceiling. Generic direct implementation was rejected; shared-direction or low-rank exceptions remain separate.

P2R0G19B_DENSE_REVERSE_ENDPOINT_TYPING_G.title: A scalar reverse proof is insufficient for all output units
P2R0G19B_DENSE_REVERSE_ENDPOINT_TYPING_G.summary: Determine whether one output-specific Bellman sensitivity can be shared across the estimator’s vector of outputs and across networks.
P2R0G19B_DENSE_REVERSE_ENDPOINT_TYPING_G.result: A deployable method needs one or a few target-free output factors. Without that factorization, the full multi-output reverse rank must be charged; a scalar off-estimator certificate is insufficient.

P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_MIXTURE_MODEL_ERROR_G.title: Testing the common-radial-scale approximation
P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_MIXTURE_MODEL_ERROR_G.summary: Check whether the affine-quadratic state really has one radial scale independent of its Gaussian block, as assumed by the exact scalar mixture formula.
P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_MIXTURE_MODEL_ERROR_G.result: Shared latent variables and noncommuting matrices can violate both assumptions. The resulting output error must be bounded, or the implementation restricted to a certified common-scale block.

P2R0G19B_R62_TILTED_WEDGE_FULL561_OVERLA.title: A local rank-62 construction detects all 561 residual modes
P2R0G19B_R62_TILTED_WEDGE_FULL561_OVERLA.summary: Construct overlapping three-row groups and a detector that separates every symmetric residual mode in the local quotient.
P2R0G19B_R62_TILTED_WEDGE_FULL561_OVERLA.result: An explicit nonzero determinant proves local rank 561. However, the constructed normal direction violates an additional orthogonality condition, so it is not yet an admissible witness for the full normal-Schur chart.

P2R0G19B_R63_BELLMAN_IRREDUCIBLE_RAW_VAL.title: Does the rank-63 correction reduce raw MSE below 1e-8?
P2R0G19B_R63_BELLMAN_IRREDUCIBLE_RAW_VAL.summary: Evaluate the exact target-specific residual-error formula, including nonlinear remainder terms and total compute cost.
P2R0G19B_R63_BELLMAN_IRREDUCIBLE_RAW_VAL.result: The formula exists, but no adequate evaluation or bound shows the required 1.9409e-8 gain from the 2.9409e-8 baseline. A held-out improvement and complete error accounting remain necessary.

P2R0G19B_AQ63_EXCEPTIONAL_SECTION_REOPEN.title: A sparse or exceptional rank-63 section remains unconstructed
P2R0G19B_AQ63_EXCEPTIONAL_SECTION_REOPEN.summary: Seek a shared sparse inverse or a target-specific cubic-null range that avoids the generic rank-63 obstruction.
P2R0G19B_AQ63_EXCEPTIONAL_SECTION_REOPEN.result: An explicit circuit, conditioning and continuation proofs, and final-output value remain missing. The exceptional cubic-null option needs at least 1,023 suitable directions; a shared sparse or fused inverse is a separate option.

P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_COMPLETION.title: Higher-order terms already implied by third and fourth cumulants
P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_COMPLETION.summary: Expand the commuting third- and fourth-cumulant operators to identify nonlinear terms omitted from the current approximation.
P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_COMPLETION.result: The exact completion includes L3L4 + L3³/6 and the next-order squared and mixed terms. This formal algebra supplies neither independent fifth/sixth cumulants nor proof of a positive density or better predictions.

P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_OLD_OVERLA.title: Does nonlinear completion add value beyond existing corrections?
P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_OLD_OVERLA.summary: Subtract the responses already represented by CP, Star, pair, and reset terms before crediting a new nonlinear read of the same source tensors.
P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_OLD_OVERLA.result: Independent response value remains unproved. A nonzero synchronized residual is required; reading the same third- and fourth-order sources differently cannot automatically count as new information.

P2R0G19B_AQ_SHARED_Z_L6_ACTION_COST.title: Applying a shared-state sixth-order term in quadratic work
P2R0G19B_AQ_SHARED_Z_L6_ACTION_COST.summary: Use the cubic and mixed coefficients from the synchronized affine/quadratic state with Gaussian degree-six derivative tables.
P2R0G19B_AQ_SHARED_Z_L6_ACTION_COST.result: The action itself is elementwise O(n²), without a new matrix carrier or reverse pass. This count assumes that the required tables and synchronized state are actually available.

P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_PAIRING_NULL_WITNESS.title: A trace response can survive after the Gaussian pairing vanishes
P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_PAIRING_NULL_WITNESS.summary: Construct an output row that cancels the Gaussian pairing response but still detects the strict trace residual.
P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_PAIRING_NULL_WITNESS.result: The explicit linear witness proves that having covariance factors does not provide every trace readout. It establishes a distinction between responses, not a measured corpus-wide prediction gain.

P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_ONE_STEP_RETIRE_GATE.title: When can a trace correction be discarded after one step?
P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_ONE_STEP_RETIRE_GATE.summary: Check whether collision reads capture every future q211 and q1111 effect of a transported trace contribution.
P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_ONE_STEP_RETIRE_GATE.result: Discarding it is exact only if all later sensitivities vanish or are already represented on the unread directions. That full future-interface condition remains unproved; immediate agreement alone is insufficient.

P2R0G19B_Q211_RANKONE_PULLBACK_CURRENT_C.title: Pulling back a rank-one K22 target is still too expensive
P2R0G19B_Q211_RANKONE_PULLBACK_CURRENT_C.summary: Price the missing rectangular reverse pass needed by the current rank-56 representation across six layer boundaries.
P2R0G19B_Q211_RANKONE_PULLBACK_CURRENT_C.result: The pass costs about 3.0625 compute equivalents per boundary, plus local products, and over 19.37 in total before the remaining broad term. The current implementation is too costly without cancellation or a fused source-specific circuit.

P2R0G19B_Q211_PSHARP_LOW_FACTOR_TAIL_GAT.title: Bounding the residual beyond the structured P-sharp terms
P2R0G19B_Q211_PSHARP_LOW_FACTOR_TAIL_GAT.summary: Split the zero-bias P-sharp plane into a constant term, a multiple of the correlation matrix, and a higher residual.
P2R0G19B_Q211_PSHARP_LOW_FACTOR_TAIL_GAT.result: The first two terms have structured computations. The remaining E3 term still needs a certified spectral or output-action bound, including bias extensions; a small factor count alone does not establish accuracy.

P2R0G19B_H211_THREE_HESSIAN_IDENTITY.title: Computing a mixed q211 query with three Hessian actions
P2R0G19B_H211_THREE_HESSIAN_IDENTITY.summary: Group the U, V, and W query directions so the mixed affine-quadratic surface calculation can share covariance-Hessian actions.
P2R0G19B_H211_THREE_HESSIAN_IDENTITY.result: An exact collision-complete identity replaces six diagonal surface rays with three mixed actions. Supplying the queries, pricing the implementation, and proving the relevant source scope remain separate.

P2R0G19B_QHEAD_FRONTIER.title: Learned local-q predictors failed to recover the oracle gain
P2R0G19B_QHEAD_FRONTIER.summary: Try several feature sources and learned heads to predict the local q state whose exact values would bring final error below 1e-8.
P2R0G19B_QHEAD_FRONTIER.result: The 82-input head, direct-transpose source, and final 86-input provider all missed their value requirements. None reached refit, integration, resource measurement, or packaging. The oracle result was capacity evidence only.

P2R0G19B_OWNED_L3_L3SQUARE_PAIRED_CONTRO.title: A matched zero-source control for four new input fields
P2R0G19B_OWNED_L3_L3SQUARE_PAIRED_CONTRO.summary: Keep the existing 82 fields and all training conditions identical while zeroing only the four new fields after normalization.
P2R0G19B_OWNED_L3_L3SQUARE_PAIRED_CONTRO.result: Static review verified the paired-control invariant. This establishes a fair comparison design, not a measured accuracy benefit from the new fields.

P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V1_INTERLOCK.title: A conditional physical-state experiment was never activated
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V1_INTERLOCK.summary: Run the proposed physical-state design only if an exact-q oracle from layer five failed to reach MSE below 1e-8.
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V1_INTERLOCK.result: The oracle instead passed at 4.6985e-10, so the condition for this experiment was false. The design remained archival and was not trained, integrated, packaged, or submitted.

P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_IMPLEMENTATIO.title: Paused repairs to the physical-state implementation
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_IMPLEMENTATIO.summary: Consolidate inference dtype, seed, output-shape, zero-source parity, resource, and provenance repairs into a new frozen implementation.
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_IMPLEMENTATIO.result: No run occurred. Work remained blocked until a descriptive network 35 check reached raw MSE below 1e-8 and passed review. The repair design itself established no estimator performance.

P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.title: Static review of a one-use descriptive accuracy check
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.summary: Verify the sequence of the nine-fit and network 35 descriptive check, including isolation and the rule to stop after its single result.
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.result: The exact implementation passed static chronology review, but execution remained paused. No accuracy result was produced by this record.

P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_G3_TRACKER.title: Tracking higher-order state directly from network weights
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_G3_TRACKER.summary: Propagate means and compressed higher-order state from the weights to supply more accurate pair corrections in later layers.
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_G3_TRACKER.result: The standalone tracker added almost no useful accuracy: correlation was 0.19–0.36 and even in-sample rescaling gained at most 0.4%. Error scale grew with depth. The method was parked while its components remained available.

P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB1_EMISSION_RETROFIT.title: Replacing the estimator’s pair-emission formulas
P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB1_EMISSION_RETROFIT.summary: Insert the engine’s validated Mehler and Edgeworth pair formulas into a copy of the estimator, then test accuracy and compute with and without its learned correction.
P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB1_EMISSION_RETROFIT.result: The formula replacement added no value; retained propagated residuals explained the mechanism. Carrying them hurt with the existing learned correction and raised utilization 17%. A refit and at least threefold cheaper carrier were needed.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_1_FORM.title: A richer pair formula cannot repair missing input information
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_1_FORM.summary: Compare exact two-dimensional Gram–Charlier consumption of the carried pair state with the estimator’s existing series.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_1_FORM.result: The results matched closely: ratios 0.99–1.01 and error correlations 0.98–1.00. Derivation and measurement placed the limitation in the supplied state, rather than a richer formula applied to the same inputs.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2E_UNIVARIATE.title: Supplying true per-unit third cumulants
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2E_UNIVARIATE.summary: Replace each layer’s univariate third-cumulant input with its true value to identify which downstream correction is limited by that input.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2E_UNIVARIATE.result: The oracle improved the third-cumulant correction but did not lift the variance arm. It located useful missing information for the former; it did not establish a computable source of true cumulants.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N5_UTIL.title: Compute savings must preserve the CP3 state’s accuracy
P2R0G19B_MECH_N5_UTIL.summary: Test smaller CP3 caps and a float32 packing change under the adjusted-score rule: raw error multiplied by max(utilization, 0.1).
P2R0G19B_MECH_N5_UTIL.result: Reducing the cap to 8,192 raised raw error 351%; 2,048 raised it 91-fold, with little compute savings. Float32 packing showed a 4.9% adjusted-score opportunity, but its combined deployment remained pending.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1A_BOND_KERNEL.title: Adding correlation terms to the CP3 propagation gates
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1A_BOND_KERNEL.summary: Replace products of independent gates with the correlated propagation kernel and measure its effect on the next layer’s third-cumulant reads.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1A_BOND_KERNEL.result: The correction was only 0.4–0.7% of the CP3 read and explained at most 1.7% of residual energy on two networks. It was too small and poorly aligned to explain the missing mechanism.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1F_HALF_SCALE_SUPPLY.title: Half-strength variance and skew corrections with the learned model
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1F_HALF_SCALE_SUPPLY.summary: Preserve the learned correction while applying half of the missing per-unit variance and skew state, then seek a computable supply with the same useful direction.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1F_HALF_SCALE_SUPPLY.result: Exact-state assistance reached 8.53e-9 and 1.650e-8 on two networks, showing capacity. Computable supplies failed to improve both reliably. The late-layer alignment problem remained open; no deployable source met the recorded requirement.

P2R0E3A1.title: Remove stored fourth-order history
P2R0E3A1.summary: Turn off CP4 history to compare it with a memoryless fourth-order correction.
P2R0E3A1.result: The exact candidate fit the resource budget but produced nonfinite values during the QR.35 fixture's PSD eigensolve. It could not provide a valid comparison.

P2R0E3A7.title: Measure the effect of PSD repair
P2R0E3A7.summary: Check whether repairing the covariance matrix materially changes estimator outputs.
P2R0E3A7.result: Repair changed nothing numerically on about 92% of calls. Its median effect was 1.86e-5 of the error scale, so the proposed ridge comparison was not triggered.

P2R0H3C.title: Reset invalid connected cumulants
P2R0H3C.summary: Test whether shutting down invalid connected terms also removes them from the stored state.
P2R0H3C.result: Returned arrays passed the initial checks, but a nonzero pairing coefficient could recreate invalid K22 terms later. This version was withdrawn before full-width runs or submission.

P2R0H3I.title: Package the minimal near-floor repair
P2R0H3I.summary: Freeze and measure the estimator with the scalar-minimal near-floor repair.
P2R0H3I.result: The meter passed with 2.127e12 FLOPs, 0.398 seconds residual time, and zero failures. Source and package were frozen; the separate #328277 receipt records the later submission.

P2R0H7B.title: Train and submit the 688-network correction
P2R0H7B.summary: Fit six epochs on 688 networks, export the correction, and verify that runtime optimizations preserve its outputs.
P2R0H7B.result: Submission #328326 achieved raw MSE 2.9409640e-8 and adjusted score 2.8472075e-8. Runtime checks passed, but raw MSE remained above the 1e-8 target.

P2R0F2F.title: Add two recurrent auxiliary states
P2R0F2F.summary: Train two extra per-unit states, transported through each layer, to improve autonomous error correction.
P2R0F2F.result: MSE improved only 0.5514%, to 3.45183e-8. It missed both the 3.12387e-8 primary threshold and the 1e-8 stretch target; this 20-epoch schedule was rejected.

P2R0F2L.title: Identify information needed for hard networks
P2R0F2L.summary: Compare the J and K corrections and test whether scalar scores or backward sensitivity identify difficult networks.
P2R0F2L.result: K improved four hard rows but worsened the other 684. Backward sensitivity aligned with residual error; scalar scores did not. This supported testing one full-width learned backward correction.

P2R0C1B.title: Reduce CP4 storage to save computation
P2R0C1B.summary: Measure whether lowering the CP4 cap from 2048 to 1024 or 1792 saves enough work without changing outputs too much.
P2R0C1B.result: The two caps saved 81.8 and 20.4 billion FLOPs, but caused pooled output drift of 1.00e-5 and 2.50e-6. Both exceeded their frozen drift limits.

P2R0F2Q.title: Add seven measures of approximation error
P2R0F2Q.summary: Give the J correction seven extra inputs describing approximation errors in the development estimator.
P2R0F2Q.result: Cross-validated MSE improved just 0.1047%, to 3.23011e-8, and missed every accuracy threshold. The inputs described a different host from the target error, leaving that mismatch unresolved.

P2R0F2W.title: Skip unnecessary covariance repairs
P2R0F2W.summary: Test conditional repair across 129 networks, checking output changes and computation saved on every row.
P2R0F2W.result: All outputs stayed finite, with maximum change 2.05e-8. Seven rows missed the required 260-billion-FLOP saving, so this version failed its preset test despite saving work on every row.

P2R0F3A4.title: Locate the remaining error in moment propagation
P2R0F3A4.summary: Measure whether truncated series, discarded CP4 terms, fifth-order moments, cubic propagation, or float32 roundoff explain the roughly 3e-8 error floor.
P2R0F3A4.result: Those candidates did not explain the floor. Measurements instead traced most error to layers 2–6 and its later accumulation; supplying true intermediate states reduced MSE to 8.2e-9.

P2R0F3A8B.title: Refit the learned correction after changing the host
P2R0F3A8B.summary: Retrain the same correction protocol on the carrier-based host and compare held-out accuracy with the original host.
P2R0F3A8B.result: Corrected MSE was 3.124e-8 versus 3.133e-8 on 40 validation networks. Retraining alone left a roughly 3.1e-8 held-out floor for this host family using the current feature tape.

P2R0F3A6B2.title: Measure which moment errors affect the final mean
P2R0F3A6B2.summary: Use Monte Carlo state estimates and final-layer sensitivities to separate errors in means, variances, third moments, and fourth moments.
P2R0F3A6B2.result: The completed network 35 audit attributed the dominant output error to accumulated mean bias, about 0.1% per step. Fourth-moment error contributed only about 5%; accurate final inputs gave roughly 2e-10 MSE.

P2R0F3B2.title: Carry fifth-order information through every layer
P2R0F3B2.summary: Investigate exact fifth-order state propagation, including direct cumulant storage and a linked-cluster representation.
P2R0F3B2.result: The direct version became unstable. Existing alternatives also terminated; the remaining family needs a common-base remainder theorem before its representation or stability can be evaluated.

P2R0F3B2B1.title: Audit the PC-TT5 exact-carry design
P2R0F3B2B1.summary: Check whether the proposed fifth-order representation has a valid reset formula, rank bound, symmetry handling, and affordable evaluation.
P2R0F3B2B1.result: The design lacked required 3–5D ReLU formulas and cost/rank proofs. Its four-unit fixture could not even contain five distinct indices. It was rejected before execution.

P2R0F3B1B2.title: Prove a joint fifth-order output correction
P2R0F3B1B2.summary: Seek a single circuit for the trivariate [311] and [221] contributions, with exact small-width checks and a complete cost bound.
P2R0F3B1B2.result: No qualifying proof or rank-at-most-13 circuit exists in the record. The route remains blocked pending a tail bound, parity checks, and total cost below 2^41 FLOPs.

P2R0F3B2B3B.title: Represent every cumulant tensor with CP rank 8 or 16
P2R0F3B2B3B.summary: Test whether a whole-tensor CP8/16 representation can exactly handle every allowed reset at orders three through five.
P2R0F3B2B3B.result: An independent-coordinate example has unfolding rank 1024, ruling out this universal exact representation. The proof does not rule out approximate low-rank corrections for particular tensors.

P2R0C1B1.title: Halve the CP4 cap to 1024
P2R0C1B1.summary: Change only the CP4 cap from 2048 to 1024 and compare the full estimator against its parent.
P2R0C1B1.result: The change saved 81.76 billion FLOPs per call, but pooled RMS output drift reached 1.00e-5. Both pooled and maximum drift tests failed.

P2R0C1D10.title: Cache depth-one CP3 workspaces
P2R0C1D10.summary: Remove repeated checks and reuse weight workspaces while keeping the depth-one CP3 computation identical.
P2R0C1D10.result: Outputs and operation counts stayed exact, but residual time on rank279 was 0.428 seconds. The frozen runtime test failed and this rewrite was closed.

P2R0G1A.title: Replace the layer-seven scalar state with exact values
P2R0G1A.summary: Supply a perfect post-ReLU scalar state at layer seven, then let the fixed scalar recurrence run the remaining layers on validation networks 160–199.
P2R0G1A.result: Even this ideal scalar-state reset gave MSE 3.38975e-8, closing only 3.06% of the autonomous-to-teacher gap. This single layer-seven scalar reset could not reach 1e-8.

P2R0G5.title: Compress the stored CP3 state
P2R0G5.summary: Try dropping old terms, retaining fixed columns, and a hierarchical compressed representation to reduce CP3 cost.
P2R0G5.result: All tested forms failed their accuracy screens. The hierarchical version projected 551 billion FLOPs but gave MSE 6.77e-8, more than twice its 3.06e-8 threshold.

P2R0G8.title: Add the mixed degree-six Hermite correction
P2R0G8.summary: Derive and test the distinct Hermite (1,2,3) contribution, removing terms already represented in the stored planes.
P2R0G8.result: The algebra checked exactly, but rank-0 MSE barely changed: 2.85678e-8 to 2.85430e-8. Its projected adjusted score, 1.21010e-8, missed the target. The separate (2,2,2) term was not tested.

P2R0G15.title: Add a scalar CP3 correction feature
P2R0G15.summary: Test whether the scalar third-cumulant contribution adds predictive information beyond the existing deployment inputs.
P2R0G15.result: Five-fold error was essentially unchanged and slightly worse: 5.39747e-9 to 5.39763e-9. This scalar feature was rejected; off-diagonal K21 features were not ruled out.

P2R0G11E.title: Shrink the learned correction globally
P2R0G11E.summary: Fit a single correction strength using held-out folds across 688 networks.
P2R0G11E.result: MSE improved only 0.07894%, to 2.97133e-8. It missed the stricter raw threshold and projected worse than the actual D4 submission; a zero-extra-cost implementation was also absent.

P2R0C1D14A.title: Use three-level Winograd products for cubic moments
P2R0C1D14A.summary: Apply three recursive levels of Winograd multiplication to the cubic carrier’s matrix products. Check the complete estimator’s output drift, repeatability, time and memory before submission.
P2R0C1D14A.result: All three local calls passed. Submission #328620 achieved raw MSE 2.9409181e-8 and adjusted score 1.8754708e-8; the maximum local residual time was 0.325 seconds.

P2R0C1D15.title: Trim depth-four workspace views
P2R0C1D15.summary: Reuse prebound views to reduce workspace handling while preserving exact estimator outputs.
P2R0C1D15.result: An isolated operation matched, but overlapping views in the full sequence retained stale symmetry metadata. The first call changed output bytes and added 125,829,120 FLOPs, so testing stopped.

P2R0C1D16E.title: Submit the corrected D5 archive
P2R0C1D16E.summary: Repair the archive and check it with the official local runner and client/server process.
P2R0C1D16E.result: Local package and execution checks passed, but submission #328628 failed generically without a score. No estimator or runtime exception was reproduced; only this archive attempt was closed.

P2R0C1D24.title: Repeat D5 in one official client/server process
P2R0C1D24.summary: Run fixtures 35, 279, and 35 in the same persistent official process to test repeatability and runtime behavior.
P2R0C1D24.result: All three calls completed with finite outputs and exact operation counts. The repeated network 35 output matched byte for byte. Peak memory was 6.70 GB; the board failure remained separate.

P2R0C1D28-K33-S0-R201.title: Test the K33 pair correction on network 201
P2R0C1D28-K33-S0-R201.summary: Run the frozen K33 candidate once on network 201 and check source parity, symmetry, cost, runtime, and memory without target access.
P2R0C1D28-K33-S0-R201.result: Most checks passed, but the measured increment was 76.180 billion FLOPs instead of the required 76.383 billion, and pre-symmetry errors exceeded 1e-10. Either failure ended this candidate.

P2R0G18B0.title: Repair and audit the signed-pair source
P2R0G18B0.summary: Correct the H16/H64/H256 source specification and have an independent reviewer check the recorded defects.
P2R0G18B0.result: The repaired source passed static review. This established the specification only; no data generation, fit, accuracy test, export, or submission was performed.

P2R0G18B5A0.title: Validate exact receipt bytes before sealing results
P2R0G18B5A0.summary: Check whether the result-sealing tool accepts the frozen receipts from earlier steps.
P2R0G18B5A0.result: It incorrectly required compact JSON even though four valid receipts were pretty-printed. The workflow could not reach result sealing; no numerical results were opened.

P2R0G18B5E0.title: Reject malformed meter receipts
P2R0G18B5E0.summary: Audit the inference/export validator's checks on numbers, booleans, shapes, and timing values.
P2R0G18B5E0.result: The validator accepted nonexact type aliases and negative-zero timing values. This frozen version failed static review before model export or runtime measurement.

P2R0G18B5C1.title: Connect refit authorization to its runtime
P2R0G18B5C1.summary: Check whether the refit permission builder produces records accepted by the exact runtime that will consume them.
P2R0G18B5C1.result: The builder could produce internally valid records, but the runtime rejected the first binding check. This version was closed without execution; an acyclic replacement design was required.

P2R0G18B5E1.title: Enforce exact types in meter receipts
P2R0G18B5E1.summary: Repair the inference validator to require exact built-in types and reject negative-zero timings, then rerun all ten defect examples.
P2R0G18B5E1.result: The frozen repair passed independent static review. It did not itself perform model inference, export, metering, packaging, or submission.

P2R0G18E.title: Find additional information for the learned correction
P2R0G18E.summary: Investigate whether richer late-layer inputs and the pair correction could jointly close the remaining accuracy gap.
P2R0G18E.result: The named K6 source failed, and known learned-input families missed the information or cost requirements. This route awaits a materially new source; deterministic propagation remains a separate open route.

P2R0G19C.title: Resolve three missing exact-propagation proofs
P2R0G19C.summary: Formulate the common-base remainder, fused 3D action, and covariance-remainder theorems as separate mathematical problems.
P2R0G19C.result: The record names these three required proofs but does not establish them. Each must yield a priced construction or a precise obstruction before its dependent method can proceed.

P2R0G19B_PANEL.title: Evaluate corrections with five-network holdouts
P2R0G19B_PANEL.summary: Build reference states for networks 35, 100, 150, 200, and 250, then fit on four and test on the fifth.
P2R0G19B_PANEL.result: The evaluation tools were completed. Using five networks reduced the uncertainty band by about 40% relative to two; the infrastructure can be extended to ten.

P2R0G19B_MATH_CUBIC_PROVENANCE.title: Analyze the DTOT2 feedback correction
P2R0G19B_MATH_CUBIC_PROVENANCE.summary: Organize the separate structural claims about the DTOT2 feedback calculation in the deployed estimator.
P2R0G19B_MATH_CUBIC_PROVENANCE.result: This node groups subproblems rather than reporting a result. Each child claim needs its own evidence; a result for one does not settle the others.

P2R0G19B_MATH_H4_CORE_INVERSE.title: Identify moments in the mixed NCQC representation
P2R0G19B_MATH_H4_CORE_INVERSE.summary: Organize the separate structural claims needed to recover moments in the mixed-frame representation.
P2R0G19B_MATH_H4_CORE_INVERSE.result: This node is a collection of subproblems, with no independent result. The open child claims must be resolved separately.

P2R0G19B_MATH_COLORED_PAIR.title: Combine projected inputs with their output calculation
P2R0G19B_MATH_COLORED_PAIR.summary: Organize the structural questions for the provider-projected, fused calculation.
P2R0G19B_MATH_COLORED_PAIR.result: This node groups the detailed claims below it. It reports no independent solution; each child calculation must be established separately.

P2R0G19B_K31_Q4_DEFICIT_THRESHOLD.title: Calculate the required fourth-order improvement
P2R0G19B_K31_Q4_DEFICIT_THRESHOLD.summary: Measure how much fourth-order correction is still needed after supplying the exact frame and signed third-order information.
P2R0G19B_K31_Q4_DEFICIT_THRESHOLD.result: The correction must reduce error by 2.86e-10, or 27.732% of the 1.0313e-9 improvement available from exact fourth-order information.

P2R0G19B_K31_AQ_DUAL_RADIUS.title: Bound error when the AQ law differs from the true law
P2R0G19B_K31_AQ_DUAL_RADIUS.summary: Find a distance between distributions that controls the fourth-order quantity used by the correction.
P2R0G19B_K31_AQ_DUAL_RADIUS.result: Total variation or KL distance alone cannot bound this error without a tail bound. A suitable cross-layer bound is still needed, or each active layer must supply an exact m31 scalar.

P2R0G19B_K31_RESET_PULLBACK.title: Check whether K31 remains representable after ReLU
P2R0G19B_K31_RESET_PULLBACK.summary: Trace a cubic K31 influence backward through a correlated ReLU reset and test whether the AQ/Jordan representation still contains it.
P2R0G19B_K31_RESET_PULLBACK.result: The scalar calculation is exact at one step, but ReLU can move it into missing H4/H6 directions. Recursive use still needs a proof or a moment oracle limiting summed leakage to 0.02520 relative amplitude.

P2R0G19B_K31_LOCAL_PROVIDER_COST.title: Find a cheap K31 contribution beyond AQ
P2R0G19B_K31_LOCAL_PROVIDER_COST.summary: Separate the inexpensive K31 matrix calculation from information already supplied by the AQ approximation.
P2R0G19B_K31_LOCAL_PROVIDER_COST.result: The cheap circuit reproduces existing AQ information. A genuinely new term starts at degree three or higher; no nonzero residual fitting one extra matrix multiplication is yet established.

P2R0G19B_K31_COLLISION_LEDGER.title: Separate diagonal and off-diagonal K31 contributions
P2R0G19B_K31_COLLISION_LEDGER.summary: Align the Q24 baseline and account explicitly for K31, diagonal K4, and all 15 terms in the full-minus-baseline difference.
P2R0G19B_K31_COLLISION_LEDGER.result: This bookkeeping and synchronization were established exactly. Whether the assembled correction equals the true distributional difference is a separate question.

P2R0G19B_K31_RESIDUAL_PROVIDER_COST.title: Factor the true K31 residual cheaply
P2R0G19B_K31_RESIDUAL_PROVIDER_COST.summary: Seek a low-rank factorization of true K31 minus the contribution already present in the estimator.
P2R0G19B_K31_RESIDUAL_PROVIDER_COST.result: Subtracting an existing scalar does not reduce the full-rank calculation. The route still needs an exact residual factorization costing at most one remaining matrix multiplication.

P2R0G19B_K31_FUTURE_AQ_CUBIC_JET.title: Isolate the first new cubic AQ reset term
P2R0G19B_K31_FUTURE_AQ_CUBIC_JET.summary: Remove existing tangent and squared terms, then examine the cubic response of the ReLU threshold projected into orders zero through two.
P2R0G19B_K31_FUTURE_AQ_CUBIC_JET.result: A candidate first surviving term is identified, but its independent value and affordable future response remain unproved. Its endpoint amplitude must exceed 1.691e-5.

P2R0G19B_Q211_COMPLETE_OLDSPAN_SCHUR.title: Check whether q211 adds an independent output response
P2R0G19B_Q211_COMPLETE_OLDSPAN_SCHUR.summary: Project the q211 correction against every response already supplied by the estimator, including CP4, K4, K31, K22, and pairing terms.
P2R0G19B_Q211_COMPLETE_OLDSPAN_SCHUR.result: The source formula is established, but useful novelty is unresolved. It must leave a nonzero endpoint contribution after all existing responses are removed.

P2R0G19B_Q211_JORDAN_ANTISYM_FUSION.title: Reuse a matrix product for the q211 commutator
P2R0G19B_Q211_JORDAN_ANTISYM_FUSION.summary: Split an already computed product into symmetric and antisymmetric parts to obtain both the Jordan term and the commutator.
P2R0G19B_Q211_JORDAN_ANTISYM_FUSION.result: At the same synchronized calculation point, the scalar commutator contribution needs no additional matrix multiplication. The identity is exact at that scope.

P2R0G19B_Q211_ROBUST_PROMOTION.title: Require q211 improvement to exceed numerical error
P2R0G19B_Q211_ROBUST_PROMOTION.summary: Combine factorization, recurrence, alignment, and floating-point error bounds before accepting a q211 correction.
P2R0G19B_Q211_ROBUST_PROMOTION.result: The required proof is still open: signal must exceed total error plus 1.69115e-5, D10 amplitude error must stay below 3.80e-6, and improvement must reach 2.86e-10.

P2R0G19B_NCQC_AQ_REMAINDER_VALUE_GATE.title: Bound the final effect of omitted AQ terms
P2R0G19B_NCQC_AQ_REMAINDER_VALUE_GATE.summary: Combine exact local AQ residual energies with future sensitivities and cross-layer residual correlations.
P2R0G19B_NCQC_AQ_REMAINDER_VALUE_GATE.result: Local residual energies are available. A complete endpoint bound is not: it still needs the future sensitivities and correlation certificate, including H4/H6 returns below 3.80e-6.

P2R0G19B_AD2_STANDALONE_COST_NOGO.title: Price a standalone second-order correction
P2R0G19B_AD2_STANDALONE_COST_NOGO.summary: Count a complete forward sensitivity pass, backward adjoint, CM calculation, and Z/q4 emission without sharing the reverse pass.
P2R0G19B_AD2_STANDALONE_COST_NOGO.result: The design costs about 70.83 or 80.83 equivalents against a cap of 49. It is too expensive as a standalone implementation; a shared replacement design remains separate.

P2R0G19B_AK_MIXED_REMAINDER.title: Bound mixed third- and fourth-order errors
P2R0G19B_AK_MIXED_REMAINDER.summary: Check the terms omitted when third- and fourth-order corrections interact over a finite-depth network.
P2R0G19B_AK_MIXED_REMAINDER.result: At L/sqrt(n)=0.5, these mixed terms cannot simply be neglected. A factorization, resummation, or endpoint remainder bound within 3.80e-6 is still required.

P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_TWO_RAY_TRANSPORT.title: Account for transporting two-column CP4 corrections
P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_TWO_RAY_TRANSPORT.summary: Price how each independent new source occupies two moving CP4 columns and displaces existing terms as it crosses layers.
P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_TWO_RAY_TRANSPORT.result: No complete replacement budget is yet established. It must include source construction, transport, Star4 cancellation, and the accuracy lost by removing incumbent columns.

P2R0G19B_CLIFFORD_FULL_STATE_CAPACITY_NO.title: Test Clifford capacity for the full network state
P2R0G19B_CLIFFORD_FULL_STATE_CAPACITY_NO.summary: Determine whether the rank-at-most-55 Clifford construction can represent the covariance of the width-1024 state.
P2R0G19B_CLIFFORD_FULL_STATE_CAPACITY_NO.result: The construction allows covariance rank at most 11, with flat correlation at most about 0.1037. It cannot replace the full D14 state; a limited auxiliary use is not ruled out.

P2R0G19B_NCQC_CROSS_DEPTH_BELLMAN_CHI.title: Include correlations between errors from different layers
P2R0G19B_NCQC_CROSS_DEPTH_BELLMAN_CHI.summary: Check whether a positive-semidefinite suffix recurrence accounts for correlations between accumulated error and newly introduced error.
P2R0G19B_NCQC_CROSS_DEPTH_BELLMAN_CHI.result: It omits those cross-layer correlations; local AQ orthogonality does not remove them. The method still needs the causal cross term, an enlarged state, or a valid endpoint bound.

P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_SIX_RAY_COST_VALUE.title: Price six-column CP4 additions and displaced accuracy
P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_SIX_RAY_COST_VALUE.summary: Count the cost of ten new six-ray contributions and the existing CP4 information they would replace.
P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_SIX_RAY_COST_VALUE.result: The additions cost about 0.9671 equivalents before source construction or measurement overhead, nearly exhausting the slack. Fewer additions or verified reuse must also repay the lost CP4 value.

P2R0G19B_Q211_PAIRWISE_STATE_SIGN_NOGO.title: Test whether pairwise state determines the q211 sign
P2R0G19B_Q211_PAIRWISE_STATE_SIGN_NOGO.summary: Construct distributions that agree on existing scalar and pairwise summaries but differ in the off-diagonal q211 contribution.
P2R0G19B_Q211_PAIRWISE_STATE_SIGN_NOGO.result: Such paired examples preserve all listed summaries while reversing q211's sign. Those summaries alone cannot determine the correction; signed higher-arity information is necessary.

P2R0G19B_FULL_AQ_RAW_GAUSSIAN_K4_NOGO.title: Test exact Gaussian initialization at limited AQ rank
P2R0G19B_FULL_AQ_RAW_GAUSSIAN_K4_NOGO.summary: Ask whether a rank-r AQ representation can exactly initialize a wider jointly Gaussian state.
P2R0G19B_FULL_AQ_RAW_GAUSSIAN_K4_NOGO.result: Its fourth cumulant vanishes only when the quadratic part vanishes, leaving covariance rank at most r. Exact full-rank Gaussian initialization is therefore impossible at r below the network width.

P2R0G19B_D14_L4_AQ55_WEAK_SECTION.title: Initialize rank-55 AQ after the fourth layer
P2R0G19B_D14_L4_AQ55_WEAK_SECTION.summary: Try starting the AQ representation after a nonlinear prefix, where the Gaussian-initialization obstruction can be avoided.
P2R0G19B_D14_L4_AQ55_WEAK_SECTION.result: The proposed suffix costs 46 equivalents, but the D14 cut is not already a synchronized AQ state. Exact state matching, a target-free reconstruction, and gauge stability remain unproved.

P2R0G19B_AQ_EXACT_GRAM_DEPTH_RANK_FRONTI.title: Calculate the AQ rank-versus-depth cost limit
P2R0G19B_AQ_EXACT_GRAM_DEPTH_RANK_FRONTI.summary: Count every required low-order Gram matrix for each suffix depth, rank, and reset-node choice.
P2R0G19B_AQ_EXACT_GRAM_DEPTH_RANK_FRONTI.result: The cost frontier was established. Reading only the final scalar avoids one rectangular product, but each candidate still needs valid initialization, accurate resets, and demonstrated improvement.

P2R0G19B_Q211_RELU_SCHUR_MODULE_IDENTITY.title: Find the exact rank support of a ReLU pullback
P2R0G19B_Q211_RELU_SCHUR_MODULE_IDENTITY.summary: Determine the column space of the elementwise product between D = VVᵀ and a low-rank pair sensitivity.
P2R0G19B_Q211_RELU_SCHUR_MODULE_IDENTITY.result: The exact support is the span of all elementwise products of their columns. For a full-rank coefficient matrix, this is the smallest common support.

P2R0G19B_Q211_SIGNED_MATRIX_GENERATOR.title: Transport q211 with a signed anchor matrix
P2R0G19B_Q211_SIGNED_MATRIX_GENERATOR.summary: Represent the source with a low-rank signed anchor matrix and two additional vectors, then derive its propagated fourth-order reads.
P2R0G19B_Q211_SIGNED_MATRIX_GENERATOR.result: Exact transport and K4/K31/K22 read formulas were obtained without Waring expansion or Star compensation. Collision handling and avoiding duplicate source contributions remain separate requirements.

P2R0G19B_AQ55_LATE_CUT_ACQUISITION_COST_.title: Price late initialization of rank-55 AQ
P2R0G19B_AQ55_LATE_CUT_ACQUISITION_COST_.summary: Compare carrying AQ through the omitted prefix, reconstructing it backward, and initializing it directly at the late cut.
P2R0G19B_AQ55_LATE_CUT_ACQUISITION_COST_.result: Warm propagation adds at least 12.46 equivalents; reverse acquisition adds about 12. Direct initialization has no bounded decoder. These generic ways of obtaining the late state exceed the budget.

P2R0G19B_AQ_PRICE_TRACE_ACTION.title: Compute a local Price trace correction cheaply
P2R0G19B_AQ_PRICE_TRACE_ACTION.summary: Contract the strict trace contribution with a CP sensitivity at one fixed calculation point.
P2R0G19B_AQ_PRICE_TRACE_ACTION.result: The contraction uses two covariance–vector products, or one in the symmetric case. If the collapsed row already exists, the final scalar is one dot product; obtaining and transporting that row is separate.

P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_TARGET_RESIDUAL_ESC.title: Compute only the effect needed by a fixed suffix
P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_TARGET_RESIDUAL_ESC.summary: Avoid reconstructing the whole late-layer state by obtaining only its cubic or direct-residual effect on a preselected suffix.
P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_TARGET_RESIDUAL_ESC.result: This remains a possible route, with no completed construction. It needs an explicit source, factor rank, conditioning bound, and final improvement without paying for full-state reconstruction.

P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_BELLMAN_TELESCOPE.title: Express final error as local Stein corrections
P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_BELLMAN_TELESCOPE.summary: Derive a telescoping sum that pairs each local Stein defect with the appropriate future Hessian.
P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_BELLMAN_TELESCOPE.result: The operator identity is exact and lets each contribution be consumed without storing a persistent H4 state. Efficiently obtaining the required hybrid future Hessian is still open.

P2R0G19B_AQ63_COMPLETE_SYM2_NECESSITY.title: Determine the quadratic capacity needed at rank63
P2R0G19B_AQ63_COMPLETE_SYM2_NECESSITY.summary: Count the pair coordinates available in symmetry-preserving rank-63 supports and compare them with the minimum required state capacity.
P2R0G19B_AQ63_COMPLETE_SYM2_NECESSITY.result: At least 1,987 coordinates are needed; the next admissible support has all 2,016. Dropping diagonal pairs therefore cannot provide a generic exact sparse representation.

P2R0G19B_R62_JORDAN_CUBIC_561_WITNESS.title: Construct 561 independent Jordan cubic directions
P2R0G19B_R62_JORDAN_CUBIC_561_WITNESS.summary: Use rank-one matrices on a 33-dimensional block to test whether Jordan products can span all symmetric directions.
P2R0G19B_R62_JORDAN_CUBIC_561_WITNESS.result: A construction supplies all 561 independent directions. This removes a universal parity or Jordan obstruction, but does not yet supply a valid full deployed state.

P2R0G19B_H3_CYCLIC_KERNEL_JPERP.title: Separate symmetric H3 information from oriented terms
P2R0G19B_H3_CYCLIC_KERNEL_JPERP.summary: Decompose the oriented quantity J into half the third cumulant plus a component with zero cyclic sum.
P2R0G19B_H3_CYCLIC_KERNEL_JPERP.result: Every fully symmetric H3 query and symmetric CP3 threshold derivative ignores the cyclic component. Any additional use of it must distinguish a slot, as in a Stein/H4 feature.

P2R0G19B_PRICE_STAR31_GAUGE_NOGO.title: Test whether covariance determines the Star31 subtraction
P2R0G19B_PRICE_STAR31_GAUGE_NOGO.summary: Compare states with identical covariance pairs but different pushed coordinate-31 contributions.
P2R0G19B_PRICE_STAR31_GAUGE_NOGO.result: The covariance pairs stay fixed under rotations that change the required subtraction, so covariance alone cannot recover it. Explicit reconstruction costs about three dense products per layer boundary.

P2R0G19B_AFFINE_Q211_COADAPTATION_GATE.title: Distinguish a physical q211 repair from a fitted feature
P2R0G19B_AFFINE_Q211_COADAPTATION_GATE.summary: Derive the finite correction and compare the evidence needed for a fixed physical coefficient with that needed for a refitted predictive feature.
P2R0G19B_AFFINE_Q211_COADAPTATION_GATE.result: The distinction is exact. A physical repair needs relative interaction error at most 10.35%; a fitted feature instead needs held-out partial correlation above 0.8124. Deployment remains unestablished.

P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_HYBRID_HESSIAN_GATE.title: Obtain the future Hessian at affordable rank
P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_HYBRID_HESSIAN_GATE.summary: Determine when the hybrid Hessian required by the Stein telescope can be computed without a width-rank boundary calculation.
P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_HYBRID_HESSIAN_GATE.result: Generic ReLU boundaries have full width rank. A cheap method still needs symmetry, subtraction of existing responses, or a shared streamed contraction, plus an endpoint error bound.

P2R0G19B_AQ_POLYNOMIAL_GRAM_SEMANTICS_FO.title: Keep polynomial AQ cores distinct from auxiliary features
P2R0G19B_AQ_POLYNOMIAL_GRAM_SEMANTICS_FO.summary: Check the meaning of replacing the AQ matrix A with a polynomial p(A), versus using that polynomial only as an extra correction source.
P2R0G19B_AQ_POLYNOMIAL_GRAM_SEMANTICS_FO.result: Replacing the core changes the modeled distribution and requires joint refitting. An auxiliary feature cannot claim the capacity or independent-component accounting of a full AQ state.

P2R0G19B_AQ_AFFINE_RADIAL_MIXTURE_GATE.title: Use an exact radial mixture for the ReLU reset
P2R0G19B_AQ_AFFINE_RADIAL_MIXTURE_GATE.summary: Model independent affine Gaussian and quadratic radial parts, then evaluate the arc-cosine kernel over their covariance mixture.
P2R0G19B_AQ_AFFINE_RADIAL_MIXTURE_GATE.result: The proposed correction may be broad and inexpensive, but its leading term is already in H4/Q24. Independence, the remaining tail's value, and derivative error bounds still need proof.

P2R0G19B_Q211_DIRECT_COMMON_RAY_ESCAPE.title: Compress q211 through invariant shared factors
P2R0G19B_Q211_DIRECT_COMMON_RAY_ESCAPE.summary: Seek shared rays, invariant blocks, or an endpoint-specific low-rank factorization that survives each reset without storing the full tensor.
P2R0G19B_Q211_DIRECT_COMMON_RAY_ESCAPE.result: These are candidate escape routes, not completed constructions. A usable version must preserve its factors through every reset, contribute value beyond existing output responses, remain conditioned, and improve the endpoint.

P2R0G19B_AQ63_DIRECT_K21_SECTION_IDENTIT.title: Construct a noniterative AQ63 K21 reconstruction
P2R0G19B_AQ63_DIRECT_K21_SECTION_IDENTIT.summary: After generic and iterative reconstructions exceeded cost, look for a shared sparse inverse, fused inverse, or exceptional cubic-null range.
P2R0G19B_AQ63_DIRECT_K21_SECTION_IDENTIT.result: No qualifying reconstruction is established. It must include conditioning, gauge consistency, the K22 continuation, and useful endpoint accuracy within the total deployment budget.

P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_MIXTURE_RAW_VALUE_GAT.title: Measure only the new value of a radial mixture
P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_MIXTURE_RAW_VALUE_GAT.summary: Subtract Gaussian Mehler powers and the linear H4 term already computed by Q24 before crediting a radial replacement.
P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_MIXTURE_RAW_VALUE_GAT.result: Only the remaining mixture correction can count as new value. It still needs held-out gain of at least 1.9409e-8, or a sufficient joint gain, after model, quadrature, and PSD errors.

P2R0G19B_R62_FULL_CUBIC_CHART_GATE.title: Extend the 561-direction construction to a full r62 state
P2R0G19B_R62_FULL_CUBIC_CHART_GATE.summary: Try to place the local full-rank cubic construction inside one consistent deployed representation with the required orthogonality.
P2R0G19B_R62_FULL_CUBIC_CHART_GATE.result: The displayed construction violates UᵀN=0. Projection preserves rank but has not been shown to preserve the required detector or determinant; full-state coverage, conditioning, and cost remain open.

P2R0G19B_AQ63_AFFINE_K21_CUBIC_FIXED_POI.title: Derive the exact cubic K21 reconstruction equation
P2R0G19B_AQ63_AFFINE_K21_CUBIC_FIXED_POI.summary: At a fixed affine seed, separate K21 into a linear term and the cubic term Q(A)ij = tr(Ai²Aj).
P2R0G19B_AQ63_AFFINE_K21_CUBIC_FIXED_POI.result: The exact fixed-point equation is A = R_F[K − offdiag Q(A)]. This establishes the equation only; an efficient, well-conditioned implementation and its future behavior remain separate.

P2R0G19B_AQ63_CUBIC_NULL_JORDAN_KERNEL_G.title: Bound the kernels needed for a cubic-null reconstruction
P2R0G19B_AQ63_CUBIC_NULL_JORDAN_KERNEL_G.summary: Determine the algebraic constraints on a 1,023-dimensional column space whose cubic contribution vanishes.
P2R0G19B_AQ63_CUBIC_NULL_JORDAN_KERNEL_G.result: The Jordan kernel must have dimension at least 93 everywhere and at least 94 somewhere. This is an exact obstruction, not a theorem giving the largest possible construction.

P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_PAIR_CONVO.title: Build higher-order pair terms from existing H3/H4 arrays
P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_PAIR_CONVO.summary: Express the degree-7, 8, 9, 10, and 12 completion weights as finite convolutions of already available H3/H4 pair arrays.
P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_PAIR_CONVO.result: With synchronized H3/H4 inputs, the calculation is O(n²) and adds no dense product or stored carrier. Storage requirements and extended-kernel constants still belong in the deployment cost.

P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_OLD_DIFFER.title: Subtract the full nonlinear reset baseline
P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_OLD_DIFFER.summary: Compare the reset with and without the added source using the same marginal, connected, and repair operations.
P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_OLD_DIFFER.result: The exact increment is F(z + Δz) − F(z). Linear source subtraction misses existing nonlinear products already at order r^(-3/2); evaluating the synchronized difference remains necessary.

P2R0G19B_AQ_SHARED_Z_L6_MODEL_DEFECT_GAT.title: Bound finite-core errors in the sixth-order model
P2R0G19B_AQ_SHARED_Z_L6_MODEL_DEFECT_GAT.summary: Test whether the finite matrices satisfy the isotropy and ordered sixth-moment assumptions used by the proposed correction.
P2R0G19B_AQ_SHARED_Z_L6_MODEL_DEFECT_GAT.result: The actual-cut defects still need an endpoint error bound. The mixed term can be broad only when the affine and quadratic covariance matrices are not proportional.

P2R0G19B_Q211_LEADING_TRACE_ONE_PRODUCT_.title: Count the cost of the leading q211 trace term
P2R0G19B_Q211_LEADING_TRACE_ONE_PRODUCT_.summary: Use H = RWᵀ for the rank-one constant endpoint mode and count the remaining reductions and collision subtraction.
P2R0G19B_Q211_LEADING_TRACE_ONE_PRODUCT_.result: The leading trace term needs one dense product per boundary: ten products over D10 without reuse. This count does not include higher q211 surface terms or a broader set of endpoint modes.

P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_FULL_SURFACE_DUPLICA.title: Avoid counting the AQ trace contribution twice
P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_FULL_SURFACE_DUPLICA.summary: Compare the standalone trace correction with the complete AQ H4 surface calculation.
P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_FULL_SURFACE_DUPLICA.result: The full surface already contains this trace contribution. The separate circuit can serve as an alternative implementation or check, but cannot claim additional accuracy; true-minus-AQ needs a new source.

P2R0G19B_Q211_SOURCE_SPECIFIC_LOCAL_SURF.title: Find a source-specific cheap q211 calculation
P2R0G19B_Q211_SOURCE_SPECIFIC_LOCAL_SURF.summary: Look for a low-rank source or early H4 contraction that avoids the generic rank cost of pulling the correction through K22.
P2R0G19B_Q211_SOURCE_SPECIFIC_LOCAL_SURF.result: Several possible simplifications are identified, but no qualifying circuit is exhibited. It must demonstrate new endpoint value after existing responses are removed; rank-one covariance alone is insufficient.

P2R0G19B_R55_BASE_JORDAN_MINOR.title: Prove the rank of the r55 Jordan cubic block
P2R0G19B_R55_BASE_JORDAN_MINOR.summary: Use a projector basis to calculate the rank and kernel of the repeated-cubic base block.
P2R0G19B_R55_BASE_JORDAN_MINOR.result: Its exact rank is 522,807, and its kernel consists precisely of two inner-derivation stabilizers. The remaining symmetric and stabilizer blocks of the full quotient are separate.

P2R0G19B_H211_THREE_HESSIAN_SAME_NODE_CO.title: Share matrix work across three AQ Hessians
P2R0G19B_H211_THREE_HESSIAN_SAME_NODE_CO.summary: Count the savings from reusing an eigensystem, resolvent nodes, and mixed directions in one grouped calculation at r49, K32.
P2R0G19B_H211_THREE_HESSIAN_SAME_NODE_CO.result: Conditional costs are 0.24314 equivalents over D14 or 0.17367 over D10, far below separate factorizations. The required reuse and future-query rank have not yet been established.

P2R0G19B_QHEAD_82_OOF.title: Fit an 82-input signed and squared message correction
P2R0G19B_QHEAD_82_OOF.summary: Add signed, absolute, and squared message inputs and test the resulting 82-input model with four-fold cross-validation.
P2R0G19B_QHEAD_82_OOF.result: Raw MSE was 2.9728904e-8. Its 0.414% gain missed the preset 1% minimum and was worse than the D11 submission, so this exact model was rejected.

P2R0G19B_OWNED_L3_L3SQUARE_FULL82_SCHUR.title: Check whether four new inputs add independent directions
P2R0G19B_OWNED_L3_L3SQUARE_FULL82_SCHUR.summary: Condition the four proposed inputs on the constant, 22 local inputs, and 60 normalized parent inputs before looking at targets.
P2R0G19B_OWNED_L3_L3SQUARE_FULL82_SCHUR.result: The four inputs retained conditional rank four at every layer. All 1,376 cached rows were hash-verified, with no semantic target access. This established additional linear directions, not statistical independence or improved accuracy.

P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2_CONFIRMATORY_HO.title: Audit a small V34 physical correction before execution
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2_CONFIRMATORY_HO.summary: Statically check the 899-parameter, 24→32→3 head, its inputs, and its operation count for the network 35 test.
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2_CONFIRMATORY_HO.result: The algebra and cost bound of 0.042 dense-product equivalents checked out. Previously exposed reference values and thresholds made this confirmatory, so the version was held without execution.

P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_CUBIC_AUDIT.title: Audit V2R1 inputs and Monte Carlo separation
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_CUBIC_AUDIT.summary: Plan an independent check of input provenance, separate Monte Carlo streams, block estimates, resource counts, and target access.
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_CUBIC_AUDIT.result: The audit is paused with no result. It resumes only after a descriptive network 35 result below 1e-8 and separate review; the current record establishes no execution approval.

P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.title: Freeze the nine-fit network 35 test runner
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.summary: Package the smallest exact runner, protocol, and manifest for the descriptive network 35 experiment.
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.result: The stable runner passed static checks in two runtimes and was frozen. Execution remains paused; this record reports no numerical result.

P2R0G19B_G3_ENGINE_CERT.title: Certify the fourth-order moment engine
P2R0G19B_G3_ENGINE_CERT.summary: Derive the emission and cumulant formulas, then verify normalization conventions and numerical integration on networks 35 and 100.
P2R0G19B_G3_ENGINE_CERT.result: The engine passed its recorded layer-level tests on both networks at roughly 0.1% accuracy without fitted parameters. Correcting trapezoid endpoints moved the scale ratio from 0.988 to 0.9994.

P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB2_DELTA_CARRIER.title: Carry the emission difference in a parallel state
P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB2_DELTA_CARRIER.summary: Try direct and rank-compressed parallel carriers so a post-hoc correction can use the residual without changing the base estimator.
P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB2_DELTA_CARRIER.result: Direct emission and row-based versions failed. Compressed carriers had relative plane errors of 0.85–0.96 in layers 1–5. No cheap form was found; the remaining residual carry added about 17 percentage points of utilization.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2_PLANE.title: Improve the third-order K21 inputs to the pair map
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2_PLANE.summary: Measure how errors in third-cumulant planes affect the estimator, and compare exact planes with those supplied by the full engine.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2_PLANE.result: Independent network 35 diagnostics found 7.1% improvement from exact K21 and 24.4% from K21/K22/K31 together. Useful content concentrates late, but an affordable deployed propagation chain remains unresolved.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2F_BETA.title: Calibrate the variance-correction strength
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2F_BETA.summary: Refit the correction strength for the current supplied state instead of reusing coefficients fitted to an older one.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2F_BETA.result: A variance coefficient near 0.40 kept the same beneficial sign on networks 35, 100, and 150. Third- and fourth-order coefficients were unstable across networks, so the instrument used variance only.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2G_ADJOINT.title: Compress third-order effects with endpoint adjoints
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2G_ADJOINT.summary: Represent the final effect of each K21 residual by inner products with backward sensitivities, reducing the required reads.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2G_ADJOINT.result: The adjoint remains a cheap screen for candidate residual supplies. Direct emission differences failed, and the linear readout was retired as a deployment route; a useful carried residual is still needed.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1B_PLANE_FEED.title: Feed third-order planes into distinct tensor entries
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1B_PLANE_FEED.summary: Add the missing plane-to-distinct contribution and measure how it improves propagated third-order moments and the full estimator.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1B_PLANE_FEED.result: The full one-step plane correction reduced error by 12.4% on network 35 and 2.7% on network 100, but added about 12 percentage points of utilization. Adjusted scores were flat or worse; affordable deployment remains unresolved.

P2R0E3A2.title: Third-order closure without fourth-order corrections
P2R0E3A2.summary: Remove the fourth-order carrier and correction terms while retaining Gaussian, cubic, and squared-cubic contributions.
P2R0E3A2.result: The width-32 run became nonfinite; finite runs disagreed sharply with the parent. The resource projection also failed. These exact bytes were stopped before an accuracy evaluation.

P2R0H1.title: Public evaluation of the Q24 moment closure
P2R0H1.summary: Evaluate the fully audited Q24 closure on the official Phase 2 test.
P2R0H1.result: Submission #328210 completed all 100 networks but had raw final-layer MSE 5.7651e-7, 57.65 times the 1e-8 target. A few high-error public cases dominated the displayed error.

P2R0H3D.title: Disable invalid connected corrections during propagation
P2R0H3D.summary: Test a shutdown rule that preserves the required tensor state when a unit reset is invalid.
P2R0H3D.result: State-consistency checks passed, but all three seeds exceeded the permitted change from the parent. Residual runtime was 0.402635 s against a 0.4 s cap. No candidate accuracy was measured.

P2R0H4.title: Public evaluation of the hybrid-floor estimator
P2R0H4.summary: Measure the hybrid-floor estimator against the official test.
P2R0H4.result: Submission #328273 completed 50 public networks with raw final-layer MSE 9.2328e-8 and adjusted score 8.9337e-8. It missed the raw 1e-8 target.

P2R0F2A.title: Predict residual error from estimator disagreement
P2R0F2A.summary: Use disagreement between analytic estimators as an observable proxy for the missing error state.
P2R0F2A.result: Proxy correlation was 0.197. Adding local features gave raw MSE 8.0738e-8, far above the 7.4731e-9 obtained when the true state was supplied. This proxy did not recover the missing state.

P2R0F2G.title: Replace tangent error transport with an exact Gaussian secant
P2R0F2G.summary: Propagate a mean correction through the exact Gaussian ReLU mean function instead of its linear approximation.
P2R0F2G.result: Raw MSE improved only 0.002149%, to 3.4709e-8. It failed both the required 5% improvement and the 1e-8 target; this curvature correction did not explain the missing state.

P2R0F2M.title: Learn residual state with backward-adjoint features
P2R0F2M.summary: Train a full-width backward feature model and test it in fourfold cross-validation across 688 development rows.
P2R0F2M.result: Out-of-fold MSE was 3.2338e-8, a 0.00836% regression. Maximum network MSE was 3.3817e-7. Both acceptance thresholds failed, and all four difficult cases remained above 1e-7.

P2R0C1C.title: Distill the estimator into smaller CP models
P2R0C1C.summary: Fit local and tree-based CP models with 1536 or 1792 components, using either truth or Q24 outputs as targets.
P2R0C1C.result: Raw MSE ranged from 1.2570e-6 to 1.4205e-6. All tested models missed raw 1e-7 and adjusted 1e-8 thresholds. This result does not evaluate recurrent Hermite models.

P2R0F2R.title: Use closure uncertainty to predict residual state
P2R0F2R.summary: Add ten measures of the Q24 approximation quality to the residual model, evaluated in the estimator’s own coordinate frame.
P2R0F2R.result: The pilot passed validity checks but regressed 0.6247% to raw MSE 3.1266e-8. The predefined rule stopped expansion to all 688 rows. Improving the underlying closure remained the next step.

P2R0F2W2.title: Conditional numerical repair in the submitted estimator
P2R0F2W2.summary: Test a conditional repair implementation on the official evaluator.
P2R0F2W2.result: Submission #328400 timed out on a private case and returned zeros, giving a score near 0.026391. The simpler unconditional version #328439 succeeded with raw MSE 2.9409e-8 and replaced it.

P2R0F3A5.title: Combine shell and tensor-state corrections
P2R0F3A5.summary: Combine two analytic corrections, then refit the learned corrector to see whether their gains survive correction.
P2R0F3A5.result: The base estimator improved from 9.04e-8 to 5.03e-8, but refitting left MSE essentially unchanged at 3.1339e-8. The analytic fixes removed error already recoverable by the learned corrector.

P2R0F3A8C.title: Retrain the corrector on all 688 development rows
P2R0F3A8C.summary: Prepare a deterministic full-data retrain for a substantially improved underlying estimator.
P2R0F3A8C.result: Blocked: no new estimator had passed the required deployment checks. The existing corrector already used all 688 development rows, so more data alone was not a new improvement.

P2R0F3A6B3.title: Add cubic and quartic terms to the κ211 contribution
P2R0F3A6B3.summary: Compute all 19 terms through order four in κ211 and add their contribution to the fourth cumulant.
P2R0F3A6B3.result: The formula matched brute force to 2.5e-14 and improved mean raw error 0.66% on three cases. The compute cost outweighed this small gain; no reduced chain-and-star experiment was run.

P2R0F3B3.title: Estimate network means with deterministic quadrature
P2R0F3B3.summary: Test structured integration rules and bounds on how much network variance their surrogates can remove within the compute budget.
P2R0F3B3.result: Measured rules and bounds failed the target: even a free degree-64-exact rule implied a 2.85e-8 floor. This closes the tested quadrature route, not every possible coupled surrogate.

P2R0F3B2B2.title: Linked-cluster formulas for exact moment resets
P2R0F3B2B2.summary: Seek a tractable reset formula that retains covariance effects and controls all omitted terms.
P2R0F3B2B2.result: The grade-3 algebra has formal capacity, but its exact implementation claim failed tail checks. The revised sparse form also failed. A separate covariance-remainder theorem is still required.

P2R0F3B2B2A.title: Test whether a grade-3 reset is exact
P2R0F3B2B2A.summary: Check whether truncating the linked-cluster reset at grade three retains the terms needed for an exact fifth-order update.
P2R0F3B2B2A.result: At correlation 0.54, the omitted pair tail was 6.2087e-4 and a missing five-index contribution was 0.070383. Formal finite algebra did not establish an exact reset; this form was closed.

P2R0F3B2B3C.title: Compress only the residual of the fifth-order tensor
P2R0F3B2B3C.summary: Preserve the exact Gaussian and repeated-index terms, then approximate only the remaining tensor with 8 or 16 CP components.
P2R0F3B2B3C.result: Blocked on an independent covariance-remainder theorem. The earlier source-blind CP16 model failed all eight action tests at 0.54–0.95 relative error against a 0.15 limit.

P2R0C1B2.title: Reduce the fourth-order CP carrier to 1792 components
P2R0C1B2.summary: Lower the fourth-order carrier cap from 2048 to 1792 components while checking the full estimator’s output drift.
P2R0C1B2.result: The change saved 20.400 billion FLOPs per call but failed the inherited drift limits. Pooled final RMS drift was 2.5038e-6, so this smaller carrier was rejected.

P2R0H8.title: Public evaluation after the depth-1 CP3 memory change
P2R0H8.summary: Evaluate the submitted estimator using a depth-1 CP3 memory arena.
