P2R0G19B_OWNED_L3_L3SQUARE_H4_AUDIT.result: The static audit passed. This establishes the reviewed control behavior, not an accuracy or runtime result for an estimator.

P2R0G19B_QHEAD_RELEASE_HARNESS.title: Harness for a self-contained estimator release
P2R0G19B_QHEAD_RELEASE_HARNESS.summary: Preserve exact source and output behavior through validation, resource checks, scoring and packaging of one self-contained estimator file.
P2R0G19B_QHEAD_RELEASE_HARNESS.result: Integration remains on hold pending a network 35 descriptive MSE below 1e-8 and separate activation review. Even a pass there would not clear the fresh-panel, scientific, resource or release checks.

P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_INTEGRATION.title: Paused V2R1 estimator integration
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_INTEGRATION.summary: Bind the audited V2R1 model to the release harness while preserving the parent output and changing only the final-layer prediction.
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_INTEGRATION.result: Integration is paused. The corrected payload requires mixed-precision normalizers and trainables, a full 16 × 1,024 return and full-return metering. Preparation still depends on the descriptive accuracy gate.

P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.title: Static audit of the network 35 descriptive test
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.summary: Review separation of the nine fitting networks from network 35, disclosure timing, one-use execution order and exact final-error reporting.
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.result: The candidate-specific static audit passed, but the handoff is paused and no empirical result exists. The audit does not establish the candidate’s accuracy.

P2R0G19B_G3_INFO_LIMIT_FORK.title: Limits of the existing pair state and isolated corrections
P2R0G19B_G3_INFO_LIMIT_FORK.summary: Check whether richer formulas or isolated exact patches can recover information missing from the estimator’s carried pair state.
P2R0G19B_G3_INFO_LIMIT_FORK.result: Exact two-dimensional evaluation matched the existing series, while isolated sector patches overshot. The recorded analyses support matched-model residual differences and coordinated corrections, rather than richer formulas on unchanged state.

P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB4_K3K4_ARMS.title: Tune third- and fourth-cumulant corrections separately
P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB4_K3K4_ARMS.summary: Measure each cumulant correction at its own best strength because the same fixed strength helps some networks and hurts others.
P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB4_K3K4_ARMS.result: True-state substitutions show potential, but current supplied corrections help some networks and hurt others. Separate frozen strengths still need stable performance on at least three networks, or rejection.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2B_PUSHREAD.title: Carry third-order residual entries discarded after propagation
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2B_PUSHREAD.summary: Retain distinct-index entries generated by propagating the K21 residual, then measure their cost and interaction with the learned correction.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2B_PUSHREAD.result: Early-layer carry improved the base model but worsened it with F2J enabled and added 17% utilization. Compression attempts failed. Later injected engine states did not beat the deployed estimator, closing this engine route at board level.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N2_K3.title: Layerwise rescaling of the third cumulant
P2R0G19B_MECH_N2_K3.summary: Correct the systematic depth-dependent scale error in each unit’s third cumulant using a frozen table.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N2_K3.result: Rescaling improved the base model on both tested networks. About 70% of deep third-cumulant error remained unit-specific; later learned corrections and injected engine states did not beat the deployed estimator.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_STATE_ACCURACY.title: Accuracy required of variance and higher cumulants
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_STATE_ACCURACY.summary: Substitute controlled errors into the estimator’s own recurrence to measure how accurate variance, third cumulant and fourth cumulant must become.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_STATE_ACCURACY.result: True states reached MSE 1.6–1.7e-9; quartering the existing structured errors reached 5.3–6.1e-9. Tiny independent variance noise erased gains. Tested cheap fixes were exhausted, leaving an affordable structured state improvement unresolved.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1D_K3_GIVEN_PLANES.title: Third-cumulant error after correcting the pair state
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1D_K3_GIVEN_PLANES.summary: Separate accumulated third-order propagation error from errors in the supplied pair planes, then test higher-order feeds and a correction refit.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1D_K3_GIVEN_PLANES.result: Even with true planes, third-cumulant error remained about 4.4–6.5% at depth. Added feeds helped, but the later integrated model’s refit reached only 3.23e-8 on validation; that refit route was closed.

P2R0E3A4.title: Remove the squared third-order correction
P2R0E3A4.summary: Test whether the squared third-order term improves the selected high-order estimator.
P2R0E3A4.result: The prerequisite moment test failed, so no estimator was selected and this ablation was never run.

P2R0H2A.title: Separate fitting targets from evaluation targets
P2R0H2A.summary: Make the 688-network fitting data available for developing corrections while keeping evaluation data and leaderboard identities separate.
P2R0H2A.result: The fitting bundle was authorized with no leaderboard-name joins or raw-dataset access. The separate selection targets remained sealed.

P2R0H3F.title: Test recursive activation in the CS3B estimator
P2R0H3F.summary: Use small networks, at widths up to 128, to check whether the frozen estimator activates its recursive state correctly.
P2R0H3F.result: Algebra and control checks passed, but the observer ran before recursive state existed. All 21 attempts failed in the harness; the estimator’s dynamic behavior was not measured.

P2R0H6.title: Find and repair high-error networks in the fitting set
P2R0H6.summary: Run the base estimator on all 688 fitting networks and apply the frozen repair to trajectories exceeding MSE 5e-7.
P2R0H6.result: All 688 outputs were finite. Eleven networks crossed the threshold; all eleven repairs finished below it. The repaired population’s final-layer mean MSE was 9.116e-8.

P2R0F2C.title: Predict residual error with a six-state recurrent model
P2R0F2C.summary: Train a recurrent model with six explicit state variables and 32 hidden units to correct accumulated estimation error.
P2R0F2C.result: Held-out MSE improved from 8.940e-8 to 3.857e-8, but missed the required 3.82e-8 by 0.98%. This particular model was closed.

P2R0F2I.title: Track both the mean and variance of prediction error
P2R0F2I.summary: Add a signed mean-error state and diagonal error-variance state to the autonomous correction model.
P2R0F2I.result: Fourfold out-of-fold MSE was 3.517e-8, 6.66% worse than the earlier reference. Both the average-error and worst-network requirements failed.

P2R0F2P.title: Learn a nonlinear residual correction through W and Wᵀ
P2R0F2P.summary: Use a full-rank weight-space round trip to predict the remaining error from the existing estimator state.
P2R0F2P.result: Out-of-fold MSE improved only 0.0107%, to 3.233e-8. Even the best truth-chosen scale of the learned direction recovered just 0.522% of endpoint error; the available inputs were insufficient.

P2R0C1D2.title: Fit a recurrent Hermite model with 128 hidden units
P2R0C1D2.summary: Test a four-epoch recurrent Hermite correction on the CP1536 estimator.
P2R0C1D2.result: Protected MSE fell 74.85% to 9.421e-7 but remained 9.42 times the 1e-7 target. Similar training error pointed to limited fit or optimization, rather than a generalization gap.

P2R0F2T.title: Add orders 25–30 to the pair-series approximation
P2R0F2T.summary: Extend the existing order-24 pair series without rebuilding the rest of the estimator.
P2R0F2T.result: The extra terms were stable and affordable, but moved means far too little: at most 1.257e-8 RMS at the final layer. They could not explain the observed error.

P2R0F3A.title: Improve the base estimator before retraining its correction
P2R0F3A.summary: Study whether a better treatment of ReLU kinks can improve the base moment estimator enough to justify a new fitted correction.
P2R0F3A.result: The tested low-order variants and their correction followups were closed. Retraining remains blocked until a materially better base estimator passes deployment checks.

P2R0F3A7.title: Build and export the composed estimator reproducibly
P2R0F3A7.summary: Build the no-eigendecomposition base with the λ³ shell and rank-4 carrier, then verify the export and splice path needed for corrector retraining.
P2R0F3A7.result: The build was byte-deterministic and finite at 1.9543e12 billed FLOPs, below 2^41. The trainer, exporter, and splice tool reproduced the existing payload exactly; this was a build result.

P2R0F3A6A.title: Locate the missing fourth-cumulant information
P2R0F3A6A.summary: Compare a larger fourth-order carrier and a rank-4 residual carrier to identify why the estimator loses fourth-cumulant accuracy.
P2R0F3A6A.result: Neither reached the required 50% recovery at layer 6. The larger carrier worsened the result, and the residual carrier recovered only 17.85%; the diagnosis remained mixed.

P2R0F3A6B5.title: Add the missing fourth-order F-form and kappa211 terms
P2R0F3A6B5.summary: Implement two missing joint-moment terms and measure whether they account for the estimator’s error plateau.
P2R0F3A6B5.result: The formulas matched to 4.02e-15. On two networks, the combined correction improved raw error by only 0.516%, below the required 2%; the remaining derived order-four terms were too small.

P2R0F3B2B.title: Carry complete moment information through successive layers
P2R0F3B2B.summary: Seek a representation that preserves all required collision terms during repeated affine transforms and ReLU resets.
P2R0F3B2B.result: The tested representations failed on accuracy, rank, or cost. Further work depends on a common-base remainder theorem before a new residual carrier and dense stability tests can proceed.

P2R0F3B2B4.title: Test dense moment propagation across repeated resets
P2R0F3B2B4.summary: Check complete third-, fourth-, and fifth-cumulant propagation on small dense networks before attempting production scale.
P2R0F3B2B4.result: Blocked: exact reset semantics still depend on an unresolved theorem. No dense autonomous stability or endpoint-accuracy result is established here.

P2R0F3B2B2C.title: Combine a sparse covariance base with a TT16 carrier
P2R0F3B2B2C.summary: Use a positive-semidefinite path/forest Gaussian base to reduce the state that a tensor-train carrier must represent.
P2R0F3B2B2C.result: The proposed form remained too expensive: a degree-three path node cost about 12,441 operations, before 61,440 per TT16 query. It also lacked a remainder bound.

P2R0C1D5.title: Test the CP3 Winograd estimator at depth four
P2R0C1D5.summary: Compare the candidate against three reference calls under the original fixed test harness.
P2R0C1D5.result: All three reference calls passed, but receipt generation failed on a Python NameError. The candidate never ran, so this result says nothing about its numerical accuracy.

P2R0C1D7R1.title: Integrate staged tensor contractions into the full estimator
P2R0C1D7R1.summary: Replace contractions with staged factorized einsum operations and test the full estimator’s time and memory use.
P2R0C1D7R1.result: The small test passed, but full calls had 1.042–1.095 seconds of residual runtime and used up to 11.62 GB. They failed the resource requirements despite exact bills and output checks.

P2R0G2.title: Represent third-to-fifth cumulants along shared directions
P2R0G2.summary: Use common action directions to include every collision pattern and the required products of higher cumulants.
P2R0G2.result: The interface is algebraically complete. A rank-13 version needs 390–520 scalars and 11.9–15.9 billion query/reference FLOPs, but measured endpoint state requires too many directions for deployment.

P2R0G1B2.title: Use Kerdock directions to reconstruct the final layers
P2R0G1B2.summary: Assess whether a joint-innovation sampler can supply the complete directional state needed by the remaining layers.
P2R0G1B2.result: The endpoint information was spread across too many directions. Even an optimistic complete-direction cost exceeded the budget; no sampling directions were run.

P2R0G5A.title: Discard old third-order components by age
P2R0G5A.summary: Keep only recent generations of CP3 components to reduce state and computation.
P2R0G5A.result: Every tested age window worsened the first test network. Errors appeared one affine layer after retirement, showing that old triple-distinct components were still needed for future transport.

P2R0G12.title: Compare learned q corrections with the native estimator
P2R0G12.summary: Test whether a learned q correction and a 0.75-scaled native correction improve accuracy enough to justify their cost.
P2R0G12.result: Board transfer failed. A later model improved all four folds but gained only 0.103% overall, below the 0.25% requirement; it also failed protected/native comparisons and remains capacity evidence.

P2R0G11B.title: Submit the 0.75-scaled correction with a frozen q model
P2R0G11B.summary: Deploy the D1 estimator with its native correction scaled to 0.75 and a fixed learned q correction.
P2R0G11B.result: Local resource and repeatability tests passed. Submission #328616 scored raw MSE 3.065e-8 and adjusted 2.216e-8, both worse than #328586; this version was closed.

P2R0C1D12.title: Reduce the D1 carrier to 768 or 512 components
P2R0C1D12.summary: Test whether smaller component limits save compute while preserving accuracy on 16 disjoint networks.
P2R0C1D12.result: Both variants cost less but increased mean MSE by 1.04% and 1.51%. Each won on only 3 of 16 networks, below the required 10; neither was promoted.

P2R0G11G.title: Package the full-688 fitted q model on D3
P2R0G11G.summary: Build and validate a D3 estimator containing the q correction fitted on the full 688-network set.
P2R0G11G.result: The archive and local resource checks passed, but out-of-fold MSE was 3.11% worse than native. Its projected adjusted score also lost to the existing D4 result, so it was not submitted.

P2R0C1D16B.title: Repair FLOP accounting in an obsolete local meter
P2R0C1D16B.summary: Correct a deterministic accounting difference and rerun the unchanged packed D5 estimator under the older local meter.
P2R0C1D16B.result: The local three-call check passed. Official FlopScope 0.12 restored the original bill, so this result did not establish deployable compliance.

P2R0C1D21.title: Start the official remote estimator test
P2R0C1D21.summary: Set up the remote test environment for the network 35.
P2R0C1D21.result: The server could not bind its socket inside the sandbox. No estimator calls occurred, so no runtime, memory, or accuracy conclusion follows.

P2R0C1D26.title: Remove repeated left-transform calculations
P2R0C1D26.summary: Measure the practical runtime benefit of byte-exact common-subexpression elimination in the estimator.
P2R0C1D26.result: The change projected 888.9 million fewer FLOPs and 825 fewer wrapper calls, but saved only 5.98 ms against a 15 ms requirement. A full-estimator test was not justified.

P2R0C1D30.title: Reduce persistent scratch memory in packed D4
P2R0C1D30.summary: Reuse scratch storage across changing ranks while preserving exact outputs and metering.
P2R0C1D30.result: Static checks saved 1.323 GB of persistent scratch. The unchanged parent then exceeded the runtime limit, stopping the test before the candidate ran; candidate runtime remained unknown.

P2R0G18B3.title: Generate and publish three experiment data banks
P2R0G18B3.summary: Run the frozen target-blind generator and publish all three banks atomically.
P2R0G18B3.result: Generation and publication completed. A downstream metadata field was missing, but the banks were preserved; this record does not establish model accuracy or authorize their later use.

P2R0G18B5C0.title: Review the all-688 refitting runtime
P2R0G18B5C0.summary: Independently inspect the frozen runtime intended for refitting on all 688 fitting networks.
P2R0G18B5C0.result: The static implementation review passed. No live refit, target access, export, or estimator result was established by that review.

P2R0G18B5G.title: Assess a four-fold ensemble diagnostic route
P2R0G18B5G.summary: Consider reusing the V4R2 branch to diagnose an ensemble of four fitted models.
P2R0G18B5G.result: The exact V4R2 branch was already terminal and could not be rerun as a diagnostic. This node adds no ensemble measurement.

P2R0G18B5C3.title: Review the second estimator builder contract
P2R0G18B5C3.summary: Check the builder’s boundaries, publication behavior, and trust rules before freezing a package.
P2R0G18B5C3.result: A 225-case replay matched exactly, but independent probes found six material defect classes. The version was stopped before a package freeze or live use.

P2R0G18B5E4.title: Review the frozen deployment inference implementation
P2R0G18B5E4.summary: Check whether the inference code preserves the reviewed runtime lineage and intended semantics.
P2R0G18B5E4.result: The independent static review passed. Export, packaging and submission execution remained closed; this record establishes no live run or numerical result.

P2R0G18C2.title: Review the output-scope sealing code
P2R0G18C2.summary: Inspect the code that records which higher-support outputs belong to an experiment.
P2R0G18C2.result: The static review passed after a review-contract repair. The code had no live output bindings and could not seal current results; this was an implementation review only.

P2R0G19B_COLL.title: Track collective skewness along the mean direction
P2R0G19B_COLL.summary: Correct the slowly converging collective mode in pairwise Mehler approximations using a cheap scalar tracker.
P2R0G19B_COLL.result: The tracker stayed within about 2% and within 1.3% on a held-out network. It improved deep third-order planes, but integration still depended on the five-network leave-one-out grade.

P2R0G19B_CARRIER_VALMAP.title: Measure which moment corrections improve final error
P2R0G19B_CARRIER_VALMAP.summary: Attribute the certified correction’s value to each layer and to variance, third cumulant, or fourth cumulant.
P2R0G19B_CARRIER_VALMAP.result: The truth-fed replay reproduced an 18.7% gain, with about 93% attributed to variance. This identifies where a future provider could help; it does not establish a deployable source of those corrections.

P2R0G19B_MATH_MIXED_SECTORS.title: Analyze external-index fourth-order commutator terms
P2R0G19B_MATH_MIXED_SECTORS.summary: Separate the structural questions behind the external-index q4(211) correction.
P2R0G19B_MATH_MIXED_SECTORS.result: This is a grouping of distinct claims. Its child records carry the individual proofs, failures, and unresolved requirements; there is no combined numerical result here.

P2R0G19B_MATH_ROOTED_C4.title: Distinguish four-cycle terms from fourth-order collision terms
P2R0G19B_MATH_ROOTED_C4.summary: Determine which fourth-order graph terms remain distinct after index collisions are separated.
P2R0G19B_MATH_ROOTED_C4.result: This is a grouping of structural questions. Each child must establish its own identity or obstruction; the container does not supply an overall accuracy result.

P2R0G19B_K31_DTOT2_PROVENANCE_DUPLICATE.title: Check whether DTOT2 introduces new information
P2R0G19B_K31_DTOT2_PROVENANCE_DUPLICATE.summary: Compare the dependency description with the hidden-state expansion to avoid counting the same correction twice.
P2R0G19B_K31_DTOT2_PROVENANCE_DUPLICATE.result: Both descriptions encode the same DTOT2 physics. A missing producer/consumer Jacobian could be new, but a different provenance description alone is not a new source.

P2R0G19B_K31_AQ_DECODER_IDENTITY.title: Decode K31 from synchronized affine-quadratic coefficients
P2R0G19B_K31_AQ_DECODER_IDENTITY.summary: Express the fourth-order K31 action using synchronized linear and quadratic Gaussian coefficients.
P2R0G19B_K31_AQ_DECODER_IDENTITY.result: An exact trace/Jordan formula, normalization conversions, and reverse gradients were derived. The identity does not show that the required coefficients are available in the deployed estimator.

P2R0G19B_K31_LATENT_SIBLING_TYPE_NOGO.title: Recover K31 from one untyped latent state
P2R0G19B_K31_LATENT_SIBLING_TYPE_NOGO.summary: Test whether one shared latent object can stand in for the external K31 tensor without an explicit generative decoder.
P2R0G19B_K31_LATENT_SIBLING_TYPE_NOGO.result: Generic compatibility fails. The untyped construction does not determine the required tensor; an explicit affine-quadratic decoder is necessary.

P2R0G19B_K31_EXACT_QUOTIENT_KILL.title: Exact scalar action spans one fixed K31 target
P2R0G19B_K31_EXACT_QUOTIENT_KILL.summary: Project onto the exact scalar action associated with a fixed K31 endpoint.
P2R0G19B_K31_EXACT_QUOTIENT_KILL.result: For that endpoint, the exact action equals the target functional and leaves no quotient residual. This does not resolve multiple endpoints or errors in approximate actions.

P2R0G19B_K31_AQ_JORDAN_COMPRESSION.title: Compress the affine-quadratic K31 action
P2R0G19B_K31_AQ_JORDAN_COMPRESSION.summary: Replace an explicit fourth-order tensor with pairings of small matrices when synchronized affine-quadratic coefficients are available.
P2R0G19B_K31_AQ_JORDAN_COMPRESSION.result: The action reduces exactly to three Frobenius pairings. This is a conditional algebraic saving; it does not establish coefficient availability or estimator accuracy.

P2R0G19B_K31_DIRECT_SITE_INTERFACE.title: Expose a direct fourth-order action at the layer
P2R0G19B_K31_DIRECT_SITE_INTERFACE.summary: Look for an existing scalar fourth-order action or directional derivative of the diagonal fourth-order potential.
P2R0G19B_K31_DIRECT_SITE_INTERFACE.result: Still unresolved: the required interface and its equivariant cost must be exhibited within budget, or shown to require information the estimator does not provide.

P2R0G19B_K31_TRUE_DEFECT_TOPOLOGY.title: Separate two candidate fourth-order defect structures
P2R0G19B_K31_TRUE_DEFECT_TOPOLOGY.summary: Study the injective three-edge star and the future Z22 graph as distinct sources with different interfaces and costs.
P2R0G19B_K31_TRUE_DEFECT_TOPOLOGY.result: This record organizes two separate candidates. Neither can inherit the other’s source-completeness or cost evidence.

P2R0G19B_K31_Z22_GRAPH_WITNESS.title: Propagate a Z22 fourth-order source one layer
P2R0G19B_K31_Z22_GRAPH_WITNESS.summary: Test whether a pure two-pair source gives useful future K31 and K22 corrections at low cost.
P2R0G19B_K31_Z22_GRAPH_WITNESS.result: The future K31 action takes one product and the fourth-cumulant diagonal is cheap. The crossed K22 branch may still require order-n⁴ work; its compressibility and value remain unresolved.

P2R0G19B_HIGH_CHAOS_STORAGE_NOGO.title: Store sixth- and eighth-order Hermite state explicitly
P2R0G19B_HIGH_CHAOS_STORAGE_NOGO.summary: Count the modes needed to carry high-order Hermite information autonomously through the network.
P2R0G19B_HIGH_CHAOS_STORAGE_NOGO.result: Even a commuting basis needs 29,260 sixth-order modes and 424,270 eighth-order modes. Dense persistent crossings exceed the budget, ruling out these explicit state banks.

P2R0G19B_Q211_COLLISION_SUMMARY_RANK.title: Count missing square summaries after collision projection
P2R0G19B_Q211_COLLISION_SUMMARY_RANK.summary: Determine how many independent diagonal-square summaries remain after existing products and anchor aggregation are removed.
P2R0G19B_Q211_COLLISION_SUMMARY_RANK.result: An exact quotient dimension is available. The remaining question is whether endpoint aggregation reduces the required rank enough to fit the product budget.

P2R0G19B_NCQC_CORE_ONE_SIDED_COST.title: Represent covariance with a one-sided rank-55 core
P2R0G19B_NCQC_CORE_ONE_SIDED_COST.summary: Use a core of dimension 1,540, larger than the network width 1,024, to represent covariance and share reset factors.
P2R0G19B_NCQC_CORE_ONE_SIDED_COST.result: Any positive-semidefinite covariance can be represented exactly and transported with one one-sided core mix. This proves representation and cost capacity, not final estimation accuracy.

P2R0G19B_AD2_TRUTH_FED_REPLAY.title: Audit the source of the 18.7% replay improvement
P2R0G19B_AD2_TRUTH_FED_REPLAY.summary: Trace whether the successful replay used corrections the estimator can actually compute from network weights.
P2R0G19B_AD2_TRUTH_FED_REPLAY.result: It loaded truth-derived and tensor-minus-host planes. The 18.7% improvement therefore demonstrates oracle capacity, not a deployable correction source.

P2R0G19B_H3_VALUE_TAIL_GATE.title: Retain enough third-order value after projection
P2R0G19B_H3_VALUE_TAIL_GATE.summary: Calculate how accurately the signed third-order response must survive projection to meet the endpoint target.
P2R0G19B_H3_VALUE_TAIL_GATE.result: With variance and quartic retention fixed at 0.98346, more than 94.79471% of third-order endpoint value must remain. A certificate achieving that threshold is still needed.

P2R0G19B_H4_TRACE_TAIL_CERT.title: Bound contamination in the fourth Hermite component
P2R0G19B_H4_TRACE_TAIL_CERT.summary: Separate the true fourth Hermite component from higher-order terms that also contribute to Taylor or polarization estimates.
P2R0G19B_H4_TRACE_TAIL_CERT.result: Finite Taylor expansions do not isolate it. A contracted high-order tail bound or exact fourth-component score below 3.80e-6 is still required.

P2R0G19B_Q211_NATIVE_RESIDENT_P_ACTION.title: Compute the complete H211 action from stored products
P2R0G19B_Q211_NATIVE_RESIDENT_P_ACTION.summary: Derive the fourth-order action assuming the ordered matrix products are already present in memory.
P2R0G19B_Q211_NATIVE_RESIDENT_P_ACTION.result: The full action is an exact reduction of two Frobenius pairings, including the commutator contribution. This identity does not establish that the products are stored or have low interface rank.

P2R0G19B_AQ_TILT_COSTATE_PAIR_RANK.title: Bound the future-query rank of a tilted Gaussian model
P2R0G19B_AQ_TILT_COSTATE_PAIR_RANK.summary: Ask whether the endpoint’s projected cubic and quartic response can be represented cheaply enough to make local Gaussian deformations useful.
P2R0G19B_AQ_TILT_COSTATE_PAIR_RANK.result: The required endpoint-weighted rank bound is unresolved. A cheap local formula alone does not pay for the future response it must act on.

P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_FOUR_RAY_TRANSPORT.title: Transport four-ray compensation through multiple resets
P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_FOUR_RAY_TRANSPORT.summary: Test whether a four-ray representation and its coordinate-star compensation remain matched after dense propagation.
P2R0G19B_Q211_CP4_FOUR_RAY_TRANSPORT.result: Generic dense transport moves the compensator outside the coordinate-star representation while the rays persist. Without an exact compatibility identity, the proposed multi-reset form fails.

P2R0G19B_AQ_Q211_NORMAL_RESIDUAL.title: Identify the genuinely new q211 correction after refitting
P2R0G19B_AQ_Q211_NORMAL_RESIDUAL.summary: Subtract all responses already owned by the estimator, including changes absorbed by its fitted affine-quadratic state.
P2R0G19B_AQ_Q211_NORMAL_RESIDUAL.result: The additive source must be the true fourth cumulant minus the owned one after complete projection and refitting. A nonzero endpoint component outside that fitted span remains to be shown.

P2R0G19B_AQ_AFFINE_H4_BAND_FORMULA.title: Derive the first omitted affine-ReLU fourth-order term
P2R0G19B_AQ_AFFINE_H4_BAND_FORMULA.summary: Compute the centered q211 contribution from the connected fourth/second/first/first-order Wick pattern.
P2R0G19B_AQ_AFFINE_H4_BAND_FORMULA.result: An explicit covariance polynomial was derived. It explains much of the diagonal projection defect, but duplicates information whenever the complete affine-quadratic surface is already included.

P2R0G19B_R54_SCHUR_HOOK_NOGO.title: Test a first-order rank-54 reconstruction
P2R0G19B_R54_SCHUR_HOOK_NOGO.summary: Determine whether an affine or first-order near-affine rank-54 section can satisfy the complete reconstruction constraints.
P2R0G19B_R54_SCHUR_HOOK_NOGO.result: A universal 52,470-dimensional kernel limits rank to 419,594 and leaves at least 51,341 missing directions. First-order reconstruction cannot work universally; higher-order effects are required.

P2R0G19B_D14_AQ55_SUFFIX_COST_SUBTOTAL.title: Price a D14 prefix with an AQ55 suffix
P2R0G19B_D14_AQ55_SUFFIX_COST_SUBTOTAL.summary: Count the major transport, reset, and eigensolve operations for the proposed hybrid estimator.
P2R0G19B_D14_AQ55_SUFFIX_COST_SUBTOTAL.result: The subtotal is 46.086 compute equivalents, leaving 2.914 before several unresolved costs. A generic extra Gram calculation would exceed the cap; this is not a complete cost pass.

P2R0G19B_AQ_R48_SIX_MATCHED_FRAME_CANDID.title: Match six Gaussian frames in a rank-48 hybrid
P2R0G19B_AQ_R48_SIX_MATCHED_FRAME_CANDID.summary: Keep six interior Gaussian frames aligned and freeze the three with least measured leverage.
P2R0G19B_AQ_R48_SIX_MATCHED_FRAME_CANDID.result: The estimate costs about 48.88 equivalents and has a flat capacity diagnostic near 6.00e-9. Only about 0.12 equivalents remain, while setup, approximation, and endpoint-value requirements are unproved.

P2R0G19B_Q211_NATIVE_AABC_RANK.title: Count the true rank of a symmetric AABC atom
P2R0G19B_Q211_NATIVE_AABC_RANK.summary: Distinguish the three generating vectors of a symmetric fourth-order atom from the rank its readout interfaces require.
P2R0G19B_Q211_NATIVE_AABC_RANK.result: The pair and anchor interfaces have rank four, requiring three K31 reads and four K22 reads. Symmetric CP rank is at least six; support size alone understates the cost.

P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_SUFFIX_ARCHITECTURE.title: Replace the last six resets with an AQ55 suffix
P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_SUFFIX_ARCHITECTURE.summary: Use D14 through layer 8, then switch to a rank-55 affine-quadratic state for the remaining layers.
P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_SUFFIX_ARCHITECTURE.result: The arithmetic fits, but a universal first-order null space and an oversized future interface prevent generic full-state replacement. Only separately justified restricted corrections remain possible.

P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_ENDPOINT_GATE.title: Bound error through six successive suffix resets
P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_ENDPOINT_GATE.summary: Account for the propagated cut error and all six newly introduced errors at the final output.
P2R0G19B_D14_L8_AQ55_ENDPOINT_GATE.result: Prefix row MSE alone gives no positive lower bound on final MSE without minimum-gain and angle certificates. The six-reset cross-error, propagation and raw partial-correlation requirements remain unresolved.

P2R0G19B_R62_CUBIC_SEAM_GATE.title: Use rank 62 for a five-reset cubic reconstruction
P2R0G19B_R62_CUBIC_SEAM_GATE.summary: Investigate a shorter rank-62 suffix when the rank-63 increment or first-order reconstruction is unavailable.
P2R0G19B_R62_CUBIC_SEAM_GATE.result: Nominal slack is 1.56705 compute equivalents, but 561 missing directions must be carried by cubic terms. Conditioning, acquisition, five-reset value, and full cost remain unresolved.

P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_ORIENTED_OLD_SUBTRACTI.title: Avoid counting third-order and Stein-square gains twice
P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_ORIENTED_OLD_SUBTRACTI.summary: Remove the oriented third-order response before assigning value to the Stein-square correction.
P2R0G19B_AQ_STEIN_ORIENTED_OLD_SUBTRACTI.result: The exact new energy is a positive-semidefinite Schur complement. The cyclic third cumulant alone does not determine the oriented cross map needed to evaluate it.

P2R0G19B_R63_DEFECT_TRANSVERSALITY_THEOR.title: State when rank-63 defects can be reconstructed
P2R0G19B_R63_DEFECT_TRANSVERSALITY_THEOR.summary: Derive a geometric condition under which the prefix’s defect space intersects the rank-63 reconstruction in enough independent directions.
P2R0G19B_R63_DEFECT_TRANSVERSALITY_THEOR.result: A sufficient incidence criterion and conditioning bound were proved. Whether the physical estimator’s defect space satisfies those hypotheses remains unproved.

P2R0G19B_CP4_SEEDED_AQ63_COST_GATE.title: Price the CP4-seeded rank-63 reconstruction
P2R0G19B_CP4_SEEDED_AQ63_COST_GATE.summary: Include residual square roots, frame normalization, and the dense build product in the proposed rank-63 layer-5 cut.
P2R0G19B_CP4_SEEDED_AQ63_COST_GATE.result: Those generic operations already slightly exceed the 0.9296-equivalent headroom before root and nonlinear-solve costs. The unfused build is too expensive.

P2R0G19B_R62_CUBIC_MINOR_GATE.title: Construct the missing rank-62 cubic directions
P2R0G19B_R62_CUBIC_MINOR_GATE.summary: Find one valid, equivariant set of coefficients whose 561 otherwise silent cubic directions are independent.
P2R0G19B_R62_CUBIC_MINOR_GATE.result: Still open: a positive 561-row Gram matrix or minor must be exhibited and verified, or a physical-frame identity must show that independence is impossible.

P2R0G19B_PRICE_DENSE_TRANSPORT_HESSIAN_B.title: Transport dense Price corrections exactly
P2R0G19B_PRICE_DENSE_TRANSPORT_HESSIAN_B.summary: Ask whether pair and trace summaries suffice for exact dense propagation of fourth-order Price corrections.
P2R0G19B_PRICE_DENSE_TRANSPORT_HESSIAN_B.result: They do not: the generic state is a Hessian operator carrying order-n⁴ information. A witness has zero collision reads but a nonzero directional contraction.

P2R0G19B_CP3_JET_LITERAL_D11_OWNER_NOGO.title: Check whether D11 owns the exact CP3 derivative source
P2R0G19B_CP3_JET_LITERAL_D11_OWNER_NOGO.summary: Inspect the actual D11 state and interfaces before treating its CP3 label as evidence that an exact derivative correction is available.
P2R0G19B_CP3_JET_LITERAL_D11_OWNER_NOGO.result: D11 omits exact Gaussian third-order terms and exposes no required derivative output or reverse lifetime. A joint CP3/q211 replacement must be implemented and priced separately.

P2R0G19B_AFFINE_Q211_JOINT_SCHUR_VALUE_G.title: Measure the joint value of affine q211 features
P2R0G19B_AFFINE_Q211_JOINT_SCHUR_VALUE_G.summary: Fit all candidate layer features together after removing the estimator’s existing response space.
P2R0G19B_AFFINE_Q211_JOINT_SCHUR_VALUE_G.result: To reduce raw MSE from 2.9409e-8 to 1e-8, the features must explain at least 65.997% of residual energy. A held-out joint Gram measurement meeting that target is still missing.

P2R0G19B_AQ_EXACT_SCALAR_CF_RELU_ORACLE.title: Compute exact scalar affine-quadratic ReLU moments
P2R0G19B_AQ_EXACT_SCALAR_CF_RELU_ORACLE.summary: Use characteristic functions and one-dimensional Fourier integrals to evaluate biased ReLU means and variances, including higher cumulants.
P2R0G19B_AQ_EXACT_SCALAR_CF_RELU_ORACLE.result: The scalar oracle is exact for a frozen core, with O(r) work per quadrature node after eigendecomposition. It replaces a scalar moment calculation; it does not supply a new external q211 plane.

P2R0G19B_AQ_FREE_WICK_HIGH_RANK_NOGO.title: Test an exact high-rank free-Wick closure
P2R0G19B_AQ_FREE_WICK_HIGH_RANK_NOGO.summary: Ask whether symmetric r × r cores can satisfy the exact degree-four free-Wick law when the quadratic Gram Q has rank greater than r.
P2R0G19B_AQ_FREE_WICK_HIGH_RANK_NOGO.result: Exactness forces rank(Q) ≤ r. Beyond that, a nonzero ordered-product defect is unavoidable, ruling out a generic exact high-rank replacement; low-rank or target-invisible-defect cases remain separate.

P2R0G19B_TRUE_MINUS_AQ_L4_CURRENT_INTERF.title: Recover fourth residual moments from existing summaries
P2R0G19B_TRUE_MINUS_AQ_L4_CURRENT_INTERF.summary: Test whether available Hermite, marginal, covariance, pair, and triple information determines the required directional fourth residual moment.
P2R0G19B_TRUE_MINUS_AQ_L4_CURRENT_INTERF.result: It does not. An exact parity example changes the fourth moment while preserving every proper-subset law; additional signed residual information or a certified tail bound is required.

P2R0G19B_NESTED_REFIT_PYTHAGOREAN_GATE.title: Bound error after jointly refitting nested feature sets
P2R0G19B_NESTED_REFIT_PYTHAGOREAN_GATE.summary: Compare finite and complete fixed response dictionaries after removing existing estimator features and refitting both.
P2R0G19B_NESTED_REFIT_PYTHAGOREAN_GATE.result: For genuinely nested fixed spaces, the excess error equals the target’s Schur tail exactly, with no cross term. Nonlinear changing columns or nonnested spaces do not satisfy this guarantee.

P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_MIXTURE_COST_RECEIPT.title: Price radial-mixture quadrature in a six-reset suffix
P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_MIXTURE_COST_RECEIPT.summary: Evaluate whether 32 scalar quadrature kernels per reset fit the remaining arithmetic budget.
P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_MIXTURE_COST_RECEIPT.result: Across six resets they cost about 0.1875 equivalents, within the nominal 0.803 slack. This prices the kernels only; construction, model error, and endpoint value remain separate.

P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_NONCOLLECTIVE_REOPEN.title: Use bias or affine variation to broaden radial corrections
P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_NONCOLLECTIVE_REOPEN.summary: Investigate whether nonzero means or nonuniform affine covariance produce useful corrections beyond a single collective direction.
P2R0G19B_AQ_RADIAL_NONCOLLECTIVE_REOPEN.result: These changes can create a full order-n² correction plane, but also increase model mismatch. Independent endpoint value, common-scale accuracy, and the complete error bound remain open.

P2R0G19B_R63_BELLMAN_IRREDUCIBLE_ERROR_I.title: Compute the irreducible endpoint error of rank-63 fitting
P2R0G19B_R63_BELLMAN_IRREDUCIBLE_ERROR_I.summary: Project a cut-state mismatch onto the available correction directions using the endpoint’s Bellman error metric.
P2R0G19B_R63_BELLMAN_IRREDUCIBLE_ERROR_I.result: An exact weighted Schur-residual formula gives the best first-order error even when reconstruction is incomplete. Actual inputs, nonlinear remainder, and achievement of the raw-MSE target remain separate.

P2R0G19B_AQ63_GENERIC_DIRECT_SECTION_STO.title: Store all generic canonical K21 inverses
P2R0G19B_AQ63_GENERIC_DIRECT_SECTION_STO.summary: Estimate memory for caching the normal systems required by a generic canonical reconstruction.
P2R0G19B_AQ63_GENERIC_DIRECT_SECTION_STO.result: The 1,024 systems need 1.072 billion scalars, about 3.99 GiB at float32, before factors or estimator state. This direct cache is prohibitive without shared structure or fused application.

P2R0G19B_CUBIC_NULL_EVEN_BOUND_COUNTEREX.title: Disprove a proposed cubic-null dimension bound
P2R0G19B_CUBIC_NULL_EVEN_BOUND_COUNTEREX.summary: Check the claim that a space with vanishing cubic traces can have dimension at most floor(r²/4).
P2R0G19B_CUBIC_NULL_EVEN_BOUND_COUNTEREX.result: An even-rank block-matrix construction has dimension m(m+1) at r=2m and all odd traces zero, exceeding the proposed bound. The separate odd-rank requirement remains unresolved.

P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_BIAS_EXTEN.title: Extend the exact zero-bias action to biased layers
P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_BIAS_EXTEN.summary: Determine the extra derivative channels required when actual late-layer means are nonzero.
P2R0G19B_AQ_OWNED_EXPONENTIAL_BIAS_EXTEN.result: Zero-bias simplification is insufficient. The biased case still needs full degree-seven/nine channels or a certified bound on their omitted endpoint contribution.

P2R0G19B_AQ_SHARED_Z_ISOTROPIC_L6_IDENTI.title: Derive the leading omitted affine-quadratic source
P2R0G19B_AQ_SHARED_Z_ISOTROPIC_L6_IDENTI.summary: Assume a joint semicircular word law and operator isotropy, then expand the shared affine/quadratic source.
P2R0G19B_AQ_SHARED_Z_ISOTROPIC_L6_IDENTI.result: The exponent and leading sixth-order omission were derived exactly under those assumptions. The result is conditional; it does not establish that the deployed state satisfies them.

P2R0G19B_Q211_LEADING_TRACE_DEFECT_IDENT.title: Derive the leading zero-bias q211 trace correction
P2R0G19B_Q211_LEADING_TRACE_DEFECT_IDENT.summary: Isolate the leading intrinsic q211 term after subtracting the complete Gaussian-pairing contribution.
P2R0G19B_Q211_LEADING_TRACE_DEFECT_IDENT.result: After subtracting the complete Gaussian-pairing contribution, the leading component is (4−π)/(16π) times the trace source Z_R. This is not the complete q211 correction or an independent new source.

P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_WR_LIVENESS_GATE.title: Reuse a matrix product before its buffer is recycled
P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_WR_LIVENESS_GATE.summary: Look for a compatible RWᵀ product already computed by the estimator so the trace correction needs no additional matrix multiplication.
P2R0G19B_Q211_TRACE_WR_LIVENESS_GATE.result: The saved D11 execution does not retain a compatible buffer. Reuse is still conditional on exact orientation, layer, mask, and lifetime matching in a redesigned schedule.

P2R0G19B_Q211_LEADING_TRACE_RAW_VALUE_GA.title: Measure the held-out value of the trace-q211 correction
P2R0G19B_Q211_LEADING_TRACE_RAW_VALUE_GA.summary: Check whether an affordable trace correction explains enough residual error to reach raw MSE below 1e-8.
P2R0G19B_Q211_LEADING_TRACE_RAW_VALUE_GA.result: No held-out residualized correlation has been measured. Cost alone is insufficient: the required Schur gain is at least 1.9409e-8, with correlation at least 0.8124 and all omitted effects accounted for.

P2R0G19B_Q211_DECORATED_CHANNEL_PRODUCT_.title: Count matrix products shared by q211 channels
P2R0G19B_Q211_DECORATED_CHANNEL_PRODUCT_.summary: Calculate how many products can be shared among decorated fourth-order correction channels.
P2R0G19B_Q211_DECORATED_CHANNEL_PRODUCT_.result: The ordinary-product count is six per layer generically, five with a common threshold, and two for the zero-bias degree-four approximation. Buffer lifetimes and collision costs remain separate.

P2R0G19B_R55_SYMMETRIC_SCHUR_TRANSVERSAL.title: Preserve all rank-55 directions in one joint construction
P2R0G19B_R55_SYMMETRIC_SCHUR_TRANSVERSAL.summary: Build a symmetric minor while retaining the 969 reserved stabilizer directions.
P2R0G19B_R55_SYMMETRIC_SCHUR_TRANSVERSAL.result: Neither the full 524,800-dimensional minor nor preservation of those 969 directions has been proved. A joint triangular construction or exact Schur-complement proof is still needed.

P2R0G19B_H211_THREE_HESSIAN_FUTURE_QUERY.title: Carry the future query needed by the three-Hessian formula
P2R0G19B_H211_THREE_HESSIAN_FUTURE_QUERY.summary: Determine whether the endpoint query supplied to a local identity can also be built and preserved through earlier correlated resets.
P2R0G19B_H211_THREE_HESSIAN_FUTURE_QUERY.result: The local identity does not solve that problem. A bounded factorization and lifetime must be proved, or the actual reverse rank must be charged.

P2R0G19B_QHEAD_PRODUCT26_DRAFT.title: Reject a four-field input draft that dropped parent features
P2R0G19B_QHEAD_PRODUCT26_DRAFT.summary: Check that a proposed learned-correction input extends the full existing feature set.
P2R0G19B_QHEAD_PRODUCT26_DRAFT.result: The 26-field draft silently omitted the frozen 60-feature bank. It was stopped before target access; the approved design instead appends four fields to the unchanged 82-input parent.

P2R0G19B_OWNED_L3_L3SQUARE_CUBIC_AUDIT.title: Audit the cubic correction runner before execution
P2R0G19B_OWNED_L3_L3SQUARE_CUBIC_AUDIT.summary: Independently inspect the runner, release bindings, and separation from targets.
P2R0G19B_OWNED_L3_L3SQUARE_CUBIC_AUDIT.result: The static audit passed with no execution access. It establishes source and target-separation checks, not a numerical result.

P2R0G19B_QHEAD_BOARD_GOAL.title: Require sub-1e-8 raw error before a new submission
P2R0G19B_QHEAD_BOARD_GOAL.summary: Set the release target for both the 688-network fitting set and the separate 88-network selection set.
P2R0G19B_QHEAD_BOARD_GOAL.result: The goal remained blocked. The accepted reference was #328622 at raw MSE 2.941e-8; no new package or submission had satisfied the required accuracy and resource checks.

P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_IMPLEMENTATIO.title: Review the first frozen V2R1 implementation
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_IMPLEMENTATIO.summary: Check whether the first immutable implementation is ready for numerical execution and release.
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_V2R1_IMPLEMENTATIO.result: Its 39 static fixtures passed, but three independent audits found parity, provenance, runtime-evidence, output, resource-scope, and replay defects. It was held with zero data execution.

P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.title: Prepare integration around the network 35 descriptive test
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.summary: Align the graph and release harness with the minimal descriptive test before considering a production package.
P2R0G19B_PHYSICAL_V34_RANK35_DESCRIPTIVE.result: Preparation was paused at static support. Integration depended on packaged network 35 raw MSE strictly below 1e-8; no production, metering, or submission result is established here.

P2R0G19B_G3_MECHANISM_FROZEN.title: Supply moment corrections with a resolvent and Wick assembly
P2R0G19B_G3_MECHANISM_FROZEN.summary: Subtract the existing engine’s matched-statistics output from a resolvent-based post-state with certified Wick assembly.
P2R0G19B_G3_MECHANISM_FROZEN.result: A three-layer stack improved raw error by 1.1% in sample on r35 and 0.6% on r100 using frozen coefficients. This establishes a transferable mechanism on two networks, not a complete deployment.

P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB5_PACKAGE_FIRE.title: Package and evaluate the selected correction
P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB5_PACKAGE_FIRE.summary: Combine the winning correction with the estimator, choose its scale by leave-one-out testing on eight networks, and evaluate an untouched gate.
P2R0G19B_PKG_SUB5_PACKAGE_FIRE.result: This is a proposed release sequence. It still requires the selected correction, validation, and at least an 8–10% adjusted-score gain before submission; no board result is recorded here.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2C_CARRY.title: Test exact third-order planes as a transport oracle
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2C_CARRY.summary: Feed the true pre-activation plane at every layer to see whether improving individual planes fixes the carried correction.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N1_2C_CARRY.result: Exact pre-planes did not improve the tested correction. The limiting error was repeated transport of distinct entries across layers, rather than plane accuracy at a single step.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N3_K4.title: Repair the fourth-cumulant supply
P2R0G19B_MECH_N3_K4.summary: Determine whether correcting the estimator’s fourth cumulant improves the final output together with variance and skewness corrections.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N3_K4.result: Forcing all three states to truth reached the noise floor, and fourth-cumulant under-scaling was measured. A stable, affordable standalone correction was still unresolved; the child record revises its cause.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N3_1_CP4_CAP_DEFECT.title: Restore fourth-order information lost during propagation
P2R0G19B_MECH_N3_1_CP4_CAP_DEFECT.summary: Measure the growing fourth-cumulant deficit and test scaling, larger carriers, and a derived correction for missing fourth-order paths.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N3_1_CP4_CAP_DEFECT.result: A frozen scale table improved host MSE by 37.5% and 29.8% on two networks. Larger caps did not help, retracting the cap diagnosis. Missing propagated path content was identified; plane rescaling was unstable.

P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1E_V_GIVEN_PLANES_K3.title: Correct the small structured variance error at depth
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1E_V_GIVEN_PLANES_K3.summary: Test how accurately per-unit variance must be supplied while keeping the deployed learned correction active.
P2R0G19B_MECH_N0_1E_V_GIVEN_PLANES_K3.result: Removing half the true variance error reduced MSE by 25% and 35% on two networks. Available predicted directions were too inaccurate; no deployable supply with correlation above about 0.9 existed.

terms.label: Moment closure
terms.meaning: Track a finite set of distribution summaries from layer to layer. The closure supplies an approximation for information that is not tracked.

terms.label: Gaussian approximation
terms.meaning: Approximate the inputs to each ReLU by a joint normal distribution, described by its mean and covariance.

terms.label: Hermite corrections
terms.meaning: Polynomial terms organized around a Gaussian distribution. They provide reusable derivatives for the moment formulas.

terms.label: Mehler / Price series
terms.meaning: Expand a Gaussian pair expectation in powers of correlation, using derivatives of the two functions.

terms.label: K21
terms.meaning: A matrix of mixed third cumulants: K21(i,j) = κ(zᵢ,zᵢ,zⱼ). Its diagonal is each unit’s third cumulant.

terms.label: K22
terms.meaning: A matrix of mixed fourth cumulants: K22(i,j) = κ(zᵢ,zᵢ,zⱼ,zⱼ). It describes a part of the dependence between squared fluctuations.

terms.label: k3 / third cumulant
terms.meaning: The third central moment. It measures asymmetry; dividing by standard deviation cubed gives standardized skewness.

terms.label: k4 / fourth cumulant
terms.meaning: The fourth central moment minus three times the variance squared. It is zero for a Gaussian variable.

terms.label: Carrier
terms.meaning: A compact representation of distribution information that the estimator transports between layers.

terms.label: CP3 / CP4
terms.meaning: Represent a third- or fourth-order cumulant tensor as a sum of rank-one terms. A cap limits how many terms are retained.

terms.label: TT3
terms.meaning: A third-order residual representation. The glossary infers “tensor train” from context; the cited source does not expand TT explicitly.

terms.label: Oracle / teacher forcing
terms.meaning: Supply reference values inside the estimator to test what might be possible with better inputs. This measures potential; it is not a deployable estimator by itself.

terms.label: Raw and adjusted error
terms.meaning: Raw error is final-layer mean squared error. The official score averages each network’s raw error × max(0.1, FLOPs / 2⁴¹). Lower is better.

terms.label: Reference “truth”
terms.meaning: Reference statistics estimated using many sampled inputs. They still contain sampling error.

terms.label: Learned correction / head
terms.meaning: A fitted model that corrects the propagated estimate. The recorded model architecture varies between experiments.

terms.label: Card
terms.meaning: The research record’s name for a particular estimator implementation or configuration.

terms.label: Network panel
terms.meaning: A specified set of networks used for a test. Some panels include training networks; held-out status must be checked in the record. IDs such as r35 identify networks, not tensor rank.

terms.label: Radial correction
terms.meaning: A shared layer-wide scale term used to approximate part of the fourth-cumulant structure.

terms.label: Gram–Charlier / Edgeworth
terms.meaning: Correct a Gaussian approximation with terms involving higher cumulants.

terms.label: Ridge fit
terms.meaning: A linear fit with a penalty on coefficient size, used to stabilize the learned readout.

terms.label: RQMC
terms.meaning: Randomized quasi-Monte Carlo: estimate expectations with randomized low-discrepancy samples.

terms.label: _gop2_gnn_step (gop2)
terms.meaning: The per-layer function that computes the learned mean correction and updated learned state. The designated file contains multiple successive definitions; the final live definition begins at line 25662 and incorporates the 961-column on-policy readout. The name's letters are not expanded in the source.

terms.label: arc-cosine kernel (Cho-Saul)
terms.meaning: For zero-mean jointly Gaussian pre-activations, the ReLU second moment is E[ReLU(z_i) ReLU(z_j)] = sigma_i sigma_j [sqrt(1-rho^2) + (pi-arccos rho) rho] / (2 pi). This is a reference Gaussian pair formula used in the research. The designated implementation's first-layer branch evaluates Gaussian Hermite terms through correlation order 6; later pair maps use terms through order 3 plus cumulant corrections.

terms.label: b carrier (collective gain mode, Sym(C x b))
terms.meaning: The collective gain mode: for a given input the whole previous layer is a little larger or smaller than usual, scaling every unit's fluctuation together; it removes all of the mean excess kurtosis and ~87% of the per-unit skew variance. The card carries its third-order part as a vector b (the trace vector t_a = sum_c K3[a,c,c] = Cov(x_a, squared norm)) in the symmetrised form Sym(C x b); the card's b holds 20-30% of the gain part, the bank and star the rest. The card's harmful error is uncorrelated with the gain part.

terms.label: beta (birth beta) / gated beta / gbeta2 / K15
terms.meaning: beta = 2 (gaussian_mean - host*g) is the birth coefficient of the pair's cross term (born = bp^2 (birth*births) + (beta*births) bp^T); gbeta2 is a physics change adding -2 host (gq - g); the gated beta (K15) multiplied that change by a per-network gate of the kink fraction f = mean(|alpha| < 1.5); every form was null at n = 24 and the beta site was closed 2026-10-13.

terms.label: BFIX gamma (b fix)
terms.meaning: A zero-cost repartition of the gain term between the b carrier and the plane: after the live-loop b update, b += _BFIX_GAMMA * (radial_new - radial)/6 * m. Built 2026-09-22 (porter), shipped at gamma 0.1 since S2 (line 3946), moved to 0.119 (the quadratic vertex, -0.05%) by the opus-solo zb4 stack (line 19837), which is the designated files' value; 0.14 flat on the final stack.

terms.label: birth / hub / newborn
terms.meaning: Birth: at each layer every unit h near its switching point (selected by min(g, 1-g) >= the gate floor) mints a pair of new bank columns p+- = s_h + t+- e_h, with s_h = g o Cpre[:, h] (zero own entry), e_h the unit vector of h, t+ and t- the pair's two weights and gap = t+ - t-; the unit is the pair's hub, this layer's pairs are the newborn cohort, and six numbers per pair (the hub coefficients) are kept from birth. Fitted birth coefficients scale the newborn weights (worth about a quarter of the physics-only error).

terms.label: bsk (_BSK, skew-corrected birth)
terms.meaning: A correction of the birth coefficient: the kink density (the birth weight d = pdf/sigma) taken to first order in the unit's skewness (opus-engineer bsk, birth = _bsk(birth, aux)); the one refit-base term that helped with the learned parts on (bsk -0.57% torch, -0.34% native on S42); _BSK = 0.434 in the designated files (shallow bowl, optimum ~0.45).

terms.label: c2 card
terms.meaning: Astra's card of mid September 2026: with the wall repair (serial-top D6 push kernel replaced by a D4 packed kernel plus a square depth cap of 4, after c2 timed out on the platform at 54-58 s local boundary wall) it was graded #330931 = 4.188e-9 on 2026-09-13 (raw 2.130e-8, util 0.1967, no timeouts), the new bank. Mapped 2026-09-16: bill 87% third-order bank (young cube-column push 31%, bank plane reads 28%, old-tier QR/projection 13%, cubic star push 10%), covariance push 8%; the final error is born in layers 12-15; every rank/age/gate dial loses; true K21+K22 planes at L12-15 would give -25% but every partial supply is poison.

terms.label: c2sub
terms.meaning: A warm-started subspace iteration (16-32 columns) producing the (C^2)_ii regressor so that the exact multiple-of-C^2 form can be removed in the pair law's diagonal regression; ~1.3% of bill for ~1.2 points, closed 2026-10-02 (e60_c2sub).

terms.label: census (bill census, key census)
terms.meaning: An attribution of every metered charge (or every tree key or request) of one prediction to its step, site or layer: the S50 census (bank push 44.4%, bank read 35.3%, dead-cut star 9.1%, L15 row-cut k3 3.5%, head 1.5%, pair map 1.1%, pair-law left 1.1%); the key census over selection networks builds the prebind list.

terms.label: centered22
terms.meaning: The designated pair map constructs the centered-square derivative rows bb - (2 m / sigma) aa and uses them in both factors of channel 22. This computes the fourth-order centered pair contribution within the series evaluation. It is separate from the K22 input cumulant plane.

terms.label: coefH
terms.meaning: The pair-law setup constructs coefH from the newborn plus/minus diagonal weights and the two signed cross weights. Its expressions combine the birth, row-form, and diagonal coefficients (_NP_BIRTHS, _NP_ROWS, _NP_DIAG) with hub statistics, pair roots, and layer scales. Later calibration experiments regenerate this table when those coefficients change.

terms.label: cohort / age / young / old tier
terms.meaning: A cohort is the set of bank columns born at one layer; its age is the number of layers since birth. Young columns are the cohorts not yet joined (ages <= 4), pushed and read exactly; the old tier is the cohorts aged >= 5, compressed into the shared rank-384 frame at the joins (layer 7 takes cohorts 0-2, layer 10 cohorts 3-5, layer 13 cohorts 6-8). The old third-order content is worth 18-29x in raw error; the old tier plus its reads are ~35% of the bill.

terms.label: D11 (card lineage)
terms.meaning: The deployed estimator lineage of early September 2026 (the 'old D11 recursion', directory public_d11_util_halving_v1): CAP256_v2 = D11 + honest closure + CP4 cap 256 with the variance head off was the board best #329754 (adjusted 1.6116e-8, raw 2.965e-8, util 0.5435, rank ~22) on 2026-09-07; its cap ladder and T-69/T-69b plane-feed records are cited by later lanes.

terms.label: D7 / D7SQ
terms.meaning: D7 executes eligible wide products as 2048-wide column packets sharing a depth-7 A transform; a final packet is zero-padded to a multiple of 128 when needed. The depth names refer to matrix-multiplication recursion, not network layers. D7SQ is the separately controlled square-product depth-7 route.

terms.label: dead cut (dead-side row cut, _DEADCUT_Z) / DCV (dead-cut covariance) / dead-cut star
terms.meaning: Two related cuts of dead units (units far below their threshold). (1) The dead-side row cut of the push (porter PT-15, 2026-09-24): the rows kept at layers 1-14 are select(a + z, 0), i.e. units with alpha > -z; z = 3.5 originally, 3.0902 (gate 1e-3) in the designated files; DC35 = z 3.5 at layers 8-14 was dead on store ranks. (2) DCV (a44, 2026-10-10): the covariance sandwich W_a' (C_aa W_a) and the star product run on the live roster only (gate >= _DCV_FLOOR = 0.001, rounded to 64, 'pad' mode, later at its true inner size), dropping 0.6-2.0e-3 of C_pre's Frobenius norm, nearly all cross covariances of the cut units; the 'dead-cut star' is that reduced covariance + star product (~9% of the bill).

terms.label: detached star (star basis)
terms.meaning: The rank-32 basis in which the star plane is carried ('star-Nystrom basis'). 'Detached' describes refits that back-propagated with that basis held constant, which misses 60-85% of the derivative for dials acting through the carried b and can have the wrong sign; run M used the differentiated basis.

terms.label: dial
terms.meaning: A scalar coefficient of the card set by finite-difference line search (or exact dial gradients) on held-out networks rather than derived: about ten physics dials (bscale, b-source, X0/X1/X2, s_carry, s_new, c0, k21n, the k4 bands, F4 theta, K4L c, GSK, BFIX gamma, SS beta, NP strength, row-cut z ...). A 'zero-bill dial' changes no FLOPs. Per-layer dial tables did not transfer across networks (E13); dial wins on the base file vanish on the readout stack.

terms.label: E1 / E2 / E3 and M1 / M2 / M3
terms.meaning: The message transform uses elementwise powers W, W^2, and W^3 on three learned source blocks. The energy transform uses W^2, W^4, and W^6 on their squared source values, then applies nonnegative clipping and log1p before the encoder. Thus M2 is the W^2 message, and E3 is the W^6 energy block. GOP2 applies rank-2 contraction to all energy blocks and to M2. Names such as E3 can also denote unrelated experiment identifiers; this definition applies to the learned-feature context.

terms.label: edge module (learned covariance edge, ecut, _GN_EDGE)
terms.meaning: A small learned covariance correction at layers 8-14 (the 'message edge'): a low-rank update of the post covariance from per-unit messages through a tanh nonlinearity, restricted (the edge cut) to the response rows x live columns the covariance edge keeps; worth ~1% MSE for ~1.2% of bill; the exact all-rows version carries nothing more. The tanh was replaced by a rational stand-in (_O20_ECUT_RADICAL_A/B), a measured approximation.

terms.label: exact switch / L14 exactness (OTT, YNT, RTT, RC)
terms.meaning: An exact switch turns one of the card's cost-saving approximations off (ECUTX, READX, STARX, LCRX, J3R): mid-layer gains that do not reach layer 15 (10-16 ladder). L14 exactness restores approximations only at the last layers, where the pushed columns feed the final k3 directly: YNT (crop z 2.5 -> 3.0 at the L13 and L14 pushes) and OTT (old-tail positive side 3.0 at the L14 push) paid (#337126 -0.10%, #337142 -0.03%); RTT (response-row floor z 1.5, a sharp optimum) and RC (read column cut, _RC_COLZ 2.0) restores did not; the stack is raw-driven and transferred at ~3/4.

terms.label: F2J
terms.meaning: A learned correction fitted to an early Phase 2 closure's residual features, with a per-neuron state transported by the weight matrix and gates and a learned source map from native features. Its value and co-adaptation were measured separately from the deterministic host. The label should not be substituted for the final October readout architecture.

terms.label: F32_COV
terms.meaning: The covariance push W^T C W computed in float32 instead of float64 (flopscope bills float64 at twice the rate): identical error on ranks 35/100 at -7% util (T-138, 2026-09-07); carried into every later card.

terms.label: F4 / F4C / cp4
terms.meaning: Every bank column stores one scalar from its birth, A = -alpha / (sigma (1 + radial/3)) of its hub, so the columns carry the Gaussian-born fourth-order star Q = sum_r theta lam_r A_r p_r^4 for free; its feed into the next births is an in-place shift of the young carried columns after the gate, g o pp -> g o pp + theta A (d/2) o pp o pp (columns at most two layers old), with a cheap anchor removing the added tensor's plane from the star. F4 (theta 0.6) shipped in S37; F4C = the exact-coefficient mixture: _F4C_THETA = the strength of F4's rule per age ((0.704, 0.665)) and _F4C_C = the strengths of the exact S1 and S2 terms per age ((0, 0.459), (0, 0.258)), applied at the end of steps 1..14 to cohorts born 1 or 2 layers earlier, 21.5 flops per element of live rows x shifted columns. cp4 was the torch screen option name (not the CP4 carrier of early September).

terms.label: FHM
terms.meaning: At layers 1-14 the effective learned mean correction is d_eff = max(d, -m), ensuring m + d_eff >= 0. The covariance recentering uses the same effective correction. ZMS tests an additional covariance projection for the units clamped to zero.

terms.label: fire / bank (submission) / S-number
terms.meaning: To fire is to submit a file to the hosted grader; a bank (banked, bank step/level) is a graded submission that became the team's best public score; S<n> names the candidate generations of the September/October line (S35 = #333111 on 2026-10-01, S36 #333429, S37 #333435, S38 #333481, S39 #333528, S40 #333559, S41 #333587, ... S63 the last of the automated refit line).

terms.label: first network / boundary run / P(loss)
terms.meaning: The first network is a worker's cold first prediction; a boundary run is the release lane's run of a candidate under the platform's setup clock plus a slow-worker stress to project wall, residual and requests; P(loss) is the modelled probability that a 100-network run loses at least one network to the 120 s wall or 0.4 s residual limits.

terms.label: flopscope / fnp / BudgetContext / whestbench / whest
terms.meaning: flopscope is the competition's metered array client (client-server; every array operation is a request billed by a weight table: matmul 2MNK, pointwise 1 per element, take 4, exp 16, transpose 0; float16 and float32 rate 1, float64 rate 2); fnp = flopscope.numpy; BudgetContext(flop_budget=...) is the metering context the grader opens per network (the file opens its own only in setup, namespaces 'prebind' and 'g5const', which is off-budget by the contract); whestbench is the harness (BaseEstimator contract: setup(context) once per worker, predict(mlp, budget) -> (depth, width) array; whest validate / package / run CLI; 0.14.0 packaged the release, 0.16.1 runs predict in a per-MLP BudgetContext).

terms.label: fragment
terms.meaning: A self-contained appended code block (fragment_<name>_v<k>.py) that wraps or overrides functions of the parent file to add one lever (fragment_k4l34_v1, fragment_lazybind_v2, fragment_governor_v4g, fragment_smprune_r002 ...); round stacks chain fragments onto a fired file with chain_round_stack_v3/v5.sh, and a fragment must pass a zero test (bit for bit equal to the parent with its strength at 0).

terms.label: gate / gate floor / birth floor / response floor
terms.meaning: The gate g = Phi(a) is the probability a unit's ReLU is open (the ReLU's linearisation), used to transport carried content through the ReLU. The card selects its rosters by thresholds on min(g, 1-g): the birth floor (which units become hubs), the response floor (which rows the read computes) and the alive floor, all 0.01 and measured at their optimum at every depth; late birth-floor raises are a cliff.

terms.label: gate33
terms.meaning: The final transport gate augments its linear skewness and kurtosis corrections by -t3^2 He5(alpha) phi(alpha)/72, where t3 = k3/sigma^3 and He5(alpha) = alpha^5 - 10 alpha^3 + 15 alpha. The source fuses these three polynomial terms into the existing gate evaluation. The label 33 identifies the product of two third-cumulant factors.

terms.label: GC-quiet predict
terms.meaning: gc.freeze of the setup object graph and a raised gen-2 collector threshold during predict (restored afterwards), to keep collector pauses (gen0/1 ~24 ms per network plus a growing end scan) out of the residual; interpreter plumbing, no computation; fired as v26g #336754 on 2026-10-17.

terms.label: GMM4
terms.meaning: A proposed endogenous propagation state with up to four positive masses, per-component means, and full covariance factors. A selected component is split before a nonfinal ReLU using a fixed three-node Gaussian rule; each child uses a Gaussian scalar moment map and order-12 Hermite covariance approximation. This is a separate proposed estimator family, not a four-component version of the signed cumulant bank.

terms.label: GNN payloads (gnn_hcap256, GNN_HCP3_8K)
terms.meaning: The learned per-layer GNN closure corrections of early September, trained as co-adapted payloads for one card each: payload_gnn_hcap256.npz for the cap256 card (CP4 cap 256, F32_COV; cand_gnn_hcap256_f32cov.py reproduced the instrument) and payload_gnn_hcp3_8k.npz for the CP3-8192 card (chain_cp3_8k.sh, 2026-09-07); un-co-adapted caps break the closure.

terms.label: GOP2
terms.meaning: The implementation preserves the full mean component and projects centered features through a fixed two-dimensional output range. It applies this contraction to the three squared-weight energy blocks and the W^2 message; the W and W^3 messages initially retain their original products. A later response-weighted rank-4 compression changes W^3 independently. The on-policy readout overrides _gop2_gnn_step but retains this message structure.

terms.label: governor / fast rescue / rescue tiers / _FAST_RESCUE_FRAC
terms.meaning: A residual-time and wall-triggered routing switch (2026-10-16, candidate_GOV_v3/v4e/v4f/v4g): it read the meter's live residual_wall_time_s and a wall projection and above thresholds (0.39/0.41/0.46 s; wall 112/118/123 s) moved the file to cheaper-in-time tiers: FULL (each covariance sandwich as one tree product), EXACT (flop-diet flags off: QL, compute, SM40, D7 ...), LEAN (learned hook, edge, K4L local term off: +36% MSE on that network), SHED (the young read returns 0: x40 MSE). The 'fast rescue' is the per-layer variant: an 'exact-algebra emergency executor' (_FAST_RESCUE_FRAC, _FAST_RESCUE_LAYER set by a runtime controller) that made _shared_old384_mm fall back to its parent route. Inert in native judges (no _active_context) and in the designated files (the map is empty at the file's last line), removed from #337641; retired by Matt's rule of 10-19.

terms.label: Gram (symmetric Gram, Gram core)
terms.meaning: A product of the form A^T A or J W J^T: the join's Nystrom sketch is built from the Gram of the joined columns, the old tier keeps a 'weighted Gram core', and _O20_GRAM_ON computes only the upper half of symmetric Gram products (exact).

terms.label: GSK / GK4 / GBK (gk, transport gate)
terms.meaning: The transport gate used to carry the inherited plane (gq_i^2 gq_j cp_ij and its diagonal), the gated young columns, the old tier's gated basis and the b carrier through the ReLU is corrected for the unit's skew and kurtosis: gq = Phi(a) + (t3/6) He2(a) phi - (t4/24) He3(a) phi, exactly d(host)/d(mu) of the card's own mean formula; one polynomial evaluation on nine per-unit rows, 5 requests a layer. _GSK and _GK4 scale the two corrections, _GBK (0) the cross-form feed. Values in the shipped file: the gk fragment sets GSK 1.0 / GK4 0.6, the opus-solo zero-bill stack zb4 sets GK4 1.0 / GSK 0.9, the 2026-10-19 release stack GK4 1.04 (platform read -0.082%); _GSK 0.8 was noise-level on the final stack.

terms.label: HCF / final-layer head columns
terms.meaning: The optional final-layer head-input fragment adds standardized physical features to the first hidden-layer bias through 128 weights per feature. The defined columns are f15_diag (the pair-carried law diagonal residualized against v, 1, and mu^2, then divided by v), f15_k31l_diag (the young pairs' fourth-chaos plane diagonal), and f15_k4_local (local fourth cumulant divided by v^2). The designated file selects f15_diag.

terms.label: hcfa / _HCF_AGES
terms.meaning: The hcfa finite-difference arms multiply _HCF_AGES, the strengths of the age-1 and age-2 cohorts used to form head column 18 (f15_k31l_diag). They change this feature's cohort weights, not the number of head units. The negative arm sets the tuple to (0.9, 0.9).

terms.label: head-input law
terms.meaning: The finding (2026-10-02 18:41Z) that the unit-specific diagonal of the pair law's matrix, (B_ii - fit)/(tr C v_i) on the read's response rows, fed as a new (31st) input column of the learned mean correction, is worth -1.8..-2.1% on the judging ranks (105 of its 128 zero weights beyond 3 se); 6 x_i is the unit-specific kurtosis the second-chaos closure implies. Direct physics uses of the same number lose; the head shrinks and calibrates it. Shipped as S42 (-1.55% native).

terms.label: hub coefficients S1..S4
terms.meaning: The exactly known fourth cumulant of a hub unit's post-activation with m legs on the hub and 4-m on the covariance column: S1 = -a pdf/v (= E f'''), S2 = 2 (g - g^2 - m d), S3 = 3 (1-g)(r2 - 2 m^2), S4 = kappa4(x) = r4 - 4 m r3 + 6 m^2 r2 - 3 m^4 - 3 (r2 - m^2)^2 (with v = sigma^2, d = pdf/sigma, a = alpha, g = gate, m = the host mean); kept per pair from birth and used by F4b, K4L, K31L4 and the pair-carried law.

terms.label: inherited vs local (born) error
terms.meaning: Splitting each layer's mean error into the part inherited from the previous layer (gate x W^T e_{l-1}, first order) and a local remainder, propagated linearly to layer 15 (the linearised total reproduces the final MSE exactly): the final MSE is 79% inherited from the layer-14 means and 22% L15-local; by layer of origin L13-15 52.5%, L8-12 38%, L0-7 7%; about 83% of each layer's error is passed on.

terms.label: join (old-tier join / join truncation)
terms.meaning: At layers 7, 10 and 13 the oldest young cohorts are absorbed into the old tier: the joined columns J are projected onto a fresh rank-384 frame built by a randomised range finder (Nystrom sketch Y = G[:, rows] of the Gram G = J W J^T + Qp core Qp^T, QR, factors Fj = Qn^T J, weighted core updated), re-truncating all old content each time. The 'join truncation' is the error of that rank cut, the only remaining >= 1% oracle item; the 'every3' schedule (L7/10/13) beat one join per layer by -2% raw at neutral bill.

terms.label: JORD
terms.meaning: Taking the Nystrom join rows in energy order (as the UVP header intended, so the leading r_u = 256 frame coordinates that keep the pair means carry the most energy) instead of index order: -0.24% MSE on 24 seeds at zero bill.

terms.label: JSK (join sketch) / JSK-lite / kc / _JSK_KC
terms.meaning: The Nystrom low-rank sketch of the joined plane columns at each join. JSK-lite (2026-10-18) computes the sketch product Y = J1 W1 J1[rows]^T on only the kc heaviest joined columns (energy lam_c^2 |J_c|^2) while the factors Fj = Qn^T J and the read stay exact over all columns and the core is rescaled to the full joined trace: bill -1.4% at raw ~0. _JSK_KC maps join layer -> kc: 2048/1536/1536 (line 6958; fired as #336854), overridden to 1536/1024/1024 by the 2026-10-19 squeeze (line 24552; fired as #337065, -0.39% adjusted on 32 store ranks), the setting of the designated files.

terms.label: K13 / K14 / K15 (scout-card screens)
terms.meaning: K13 = K4L ages 3-4 at the final layer only on top of gk (k4lf34 / k4lf34h; passed, -0.199% on the board as #335709); K14 = the banded beta scan (gbs -0.5 at L5-9, +1 at L10-11, -0.5 at L12-14), null; K15 = the gated beta, null. Not cumulant orders.

terms.label: K31
terms.meaning: The plane kappa(z_i, z_i, z_i, z_j). In the card it is a per-row form, T31 = t4 * rowfactor * rho with the per-row K31 scale rowf = c0 + c1 * mu*k3/v^2 (table _K31R_TABLE, (0.85, 0.5) at port time); the pair-carried law (NCAR6) and K31L4 add network-specific content to its remainder slot. The true (3,1) plane is only 19-23% explained by those terms.

terms.label: K31L4 / NP-K3L / _NP_K3L
terms.meaning: The fourth-chaos part of the young pairs' local quartic (the part no second-chaos carrier holds) as a (3,1) plane. K4L uses the pair's local quartic Q = e1 p^3 D + e2 p^2 D^2 + e3 p D^3 + e4 D^4 on its pushed columns p (+) and q (-), D = p - q, on the diagonal only; the plane is K31L_ij = (1/4) sum_h [dQ/dp_i p_j + dQ/dD_i D_j] minus its second-chaos projection (two of the three i-slots replaced by the pair's means of p^2, pD, D^2), which the pair law already carries; used as K21_eff = K21 - (mu_i/(3 v_i)) K31L on the read's rows and columns, folded into the same read's left factor as a cubic-plus-linear polynomial per column (switch _NP_K3L; per-layer strengths per age _NP_K3L_BY_LAYER; ages 1-2 shipped in S41, a third age by RAD, age 4 viable only as a layer band).

terms.label: k4 bands (k4a / k4b / k4c)
terms.meaning: Three per-layer-band dial multipliers on the card's isotropic per-unit k4 = radial v^2 (the k4 band dial scales the base radial k4 before K4L adds its dk); in the file the triple _S19_K4BAND, (0.9826, 0.9812, 0.9613) in the designated files' micro-stack; +-1% / +-2% 'k4band' arms were flat on the final stack.

terms.label: K4L / _K4L_C / _K4L_AGE
terms.meaning: Each young pair born at hub h contributes to the per-unit fourth cumulant of unit i the local quartic loc_i = 4 S1 Y^3 Wt + 6 S2 Y^2 Wt^2 + 4 S3 Y Wt^3 + S4 Wt^4 (Wt and Y the pair's transported legs, S1..S4 the hub's exact birth coefficients); the isotropic level is kept by a weighted regression and k4_i += c dk_i. Native form: the quartic is written on the pushed columns p and D = p - q as D (e1 p^3 + D (e2 p^2 + D (e3 p + e4 D))) with four coefficients per pair fixed at birth, 12 flops per element of rows x pairs, float32; rows the row cuts do not push get no correction. _K4L_C is the strength per age ((0.873, 0.725) in the fragment, (0.814, 0.676) in the designated files' micro-stack), _K4L_AGE the age window (2; 4 where K4L34 is on). -2.8% pooled torch at birth, -1.4% on fresh ranks on top of F4.

terms.label: K4L34 / k4lf34h
terms.meaning: The K4L hub terms taken from pairs aged 3-4: k4lf34h = at the final layer only at strength 0.5 (fired in #335709, board -0.199%); K4L34 = also at the inner layers 8-15 at strength 0.5 (arm C, -0.51% on 24 networks), carried in the file as _K4L34_BY_LAYER = {8..15: (0.5, 0.5)} (a wrapper of _k4l_local that appends the two strengths and sets the age window to 4 at the listed layers); strengths 0.3/0.7/1.0 and ages 5-6 null.

terms.label: kappa_C (recentering, KC lever)
terms.meaning: The learned-correction covariance-recentering coefficient. For mean correction d, S = host d^T + d host^T + d d^T; the native implementation subtracts (1 + rc_l - kc_l) S using effective dial rc_l - kc_l. Different records use kappa for the net scale and kc for the add-back, so their numerical values are not interchangeable without the rc convention. Lowercase kc in JSK denotes a join-sketch column count instead.

terms.label: kink (kink unit)
terms.meaning: A unit whose pre-activation mean is near zero relative to its spread (|a| = |mu/sigma| < 1.5 in the file's kink mask; |a| < 1 in the oracles): at the kink the post-ReLU mean is maximally sensitive to the variance and the k3 sensitivity vanishes. Kink units are the birth hubs of the bank and carry most of the late-born error (the top 5% of L14 units carry 54% of it).

terms.label: kurtosis cap defect
terms.meaning: Finding of 2026-09-02 (phase-2 cross review): the deployed card's per-unit kurtosis was under-scaled 13% (L2) to 63% (L15) against the 32M truth; first attributed to the CP4 rank-2048 top-energy cap dropping unit-vector births, then (T-49) to the fourth-order planes K22/K31 losing about half of the (3,1)/(2,2) content born at each layer because the plane-only push does not carry the distinct fourth-order classes; frozen per-layer k3/k4 rescale tables were a zero-cost improvement at the time.

terms.label: L3o / _l3o_last
terms.meaning: The L3o output routine reconstructs the terminal quadrants of a recursive matrix product, combining the upper output half as one pair addition. Later _l3o_last overrides reuse owned output views and batch terminal additions. It is an output-transform helper, not a mathematical layer-3 correction.

terms.label: LCR / _LCR_RU
terms.meaning: At layers 10-14, reconstruct the old tier's common pair component using only _LCR_RU coordinates while retaining every difference direction and all signed coefficients. The carried frame, core, and Q remain unchanged. LCRX sets the common rank to 384; the retained setting is 256. This is a local reconstruction approximation, not a reduction in the transported frame's rank.

terms.label: low-rank star (_lr_factor randomized SVD, _LR_K / _LR_Q / _LR_R / _LR_SEED, S1LR, lrnys)
terms.meaning: The star plane A is carried as Q B with a randomized range finder: Y = A Omega (Omega a fixed n x 48 Gaussian drawn once from the seeded generator _LR_SEED = 20260924), Q = qr(Y), one power step with re-orthonormalisation (_LR_Q = 1, needed because the star's spectrum is flat: 98% of its energy needs rank 131-720), B = Q^T A and an exact truncation to rank _LR_R = 32 (a randomized SVD); the push and the s2 product then run as thin products.
